meta.title: 中西医发展对照时间轴
meta.title_en: A Comparative Timeline of Chinese and Western Medicine

events.title: 旧石器晚期龋齿处理证据
events.title_en: Evidence of Late Paleolithic dental treatment
events.summary: 意大利北部旧石器晚期人类遗骸显示对龋齿的干预痕迹，是目前已知较早的牙科操作证据之一。说明史前人群已尝试缓解口腔疼痛。
events.summary_en: Late Paleolithic human remains from northern Italy show traces of intervention on dental caries, among the earlier known evidence of dental procedures. Prehistoric people were already trying to relieve oral pain.
events.material: 旧石器晚期人类遗骸上的龋齿干预痕迹
events.material_en: Traces of intervention on dental caries in Late Paleolithic human remains

events.title: 乌克兰中石器时代开颅术证据
events.title_en: Mesolithic trepanation evidence from Ukraine
events.summary: 乌克兰发现约公元前7300–6200年的颅骨开颅痕迹，且有愈合迹象，提示患者术后存活。开颅是旧大陆多种文化中反复出现的外科实践。
events.summary_en: Skulls from Ukraine, dated about 7300–6200 BCE, show trepanation marks and signs of healing, which suggests the person survived the operation. Trepanation was a surgical practice that recurred across many cultures of the Old World.
events.material: 颅骨开颅痕迹，有愈合迹象
events.material_en: Trepanation marks on skulls, with signs of healing

events.title: 新石器时代砭石疗法
events.title_en: Neolithic bian-stone therapy
events.summary: 中国新石器时代遗址出土砭石，用于刺脓、放血与熨灸相关实践。砭石是后世针具的重要前身，但与成熟经络针刺学说有别。
events.summary_en: Bian stones unearthed at Neolithic sites in China were used in practices related to lancing abscesses, bloodletting, and hot pressing or moxibustion. They are an important forerunner of later needles, but they are not the same as the mature channel-and-needling doctrine.
events.material: 用于刺脓、放血与熨灸相关实践的砭石
events.material_en: Bian stones used in practices related to lancing abscesses, bloodletting, and hot pressing or moxibustion

events.title: 酒的发明与药酒传统萌芽
events.title_en: The invention of alcohol and the beginnings of medicinal wine
events.summary: 考古与文献传统将酒的出现追溯至史前—新石器晚期；酒后成为中药炮制、药酒与“汤液”传统的重要溶媒。传说成分需谨慎对待。
events.summary_en: Archaeology and the written tradition trace alcohol back to prehistory and the late Neolithic. Wine later became an important solvent for processing Chinese medicines, medicinal wines, and the “decoction” tradition. The legendary parts of this story should be treated cautiously.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 冰人奥茨携带抗真菌/驱虫真菌
events.title_en: Ötzi the Iceman carried antifungal and anthelmintic fungus
events.summary: 阿尔卑斯冰人Ötzi（约前3350–前3105）携带桦多孔菌，该真菌含抗鞭虫树脂并可致泻，或与寄生虫感染相关的自我用药有关。
events.summary_en: Ötzi, the Alpine iceman (about 3350–3105 BCE), carried birch polypore. The fungus contains whipworm-resistant resins and can act as a laxative, and may be linked to self-medication for parasitic infection.
events.material: 冰人奥茨随身携带的桦多孔菌
events.material_en: Birch polypore fungus carried by the Alpine iceman Ötzi
events.address: 意大利博尔扎诺 Via Museo 43

events.title: 伊姆霍特普：埃及医神原型
events.title_en: Imhotep, prototype of an Egyptian god of medicine
events.summary: 约公元前2600年，建筑师兼祭司医师伊姆霍特普被后世尊为埃及医学之神。传统上认为他描述了多种疾病的诊治，但文献证据多为后世追述。
events.summary_en: Around 2600 BCE the architect and priest-physician Imhotep was later revered as a god of Egyptian medicine. Tradition credits him with describing the diagnosis and treatment of many diseases, but the written evidence is mostly retrospective.

events.title: 埃及宫廷眼科与内科医师铭文
events.title_en: Inscriptions naming Egyptian court eye and internal physicians
events.summary: 约公元前2500年埃及铭文记载宫廷眼科医师、腹部医师等专科头衔，反映古埃及医学已有一定专科分工。
events.summary_en: Egyptian inscriptions of about 2500 BCE record court titles such as ophthalmologist and physician of the abdomen, evidence that ancient Egyptian medicine already had a degree of specialization.
events.material: 记载宫廷眼科医师、腹部医师等专科头衔的铭文
events.material_en: Inscriptions recording court titles such as ophthalmologist and physician of the abdomen

events.title: 卡胡恩妇科纸草
events.title_en: Kahun Gynaecological Papyrus
events.summary: 卡胡恩（Kahun/Lahun）妇科纸草约成于前1825年，是现存最早的妇科医学文献之一，涉及妊娠、生育与避孕等内容。
events.summary_en: The Kahun (Lahun) Gynaecological Papyrus was composed about 1825 BCE. It is one of the earliest surviving gynecological texts, covering pregnancy, childbirth, and contraception.
events.material: 妇科纸草，涉及妊娠、生育与避孕
events.material_en: A gynecological papyrus covering pregnancy, childbirth, and contraception
events.repository: 伦敦大学学院皮特里埃及考古博物馆
events.repository_en: Petrie Museum of Egyptian Archaeology, UCL

events.title: 《汉谟拉比法典》外科责任条款
events.title_en: Surgical liability clauses in the Code of Hammurabi
events.summary: 巴比伦《汉谟拉比法典》（约前1750）含对手术成功/失败的奖惩规定，是已知最早系统化的医事法律责任文本之一。
events.summary_en: The Babylonian Code of Hammurabi (about 1750 BCE) sets rewards and penalties for successful and failed surgery. It is one of the earliest known systematic texts on legal liability in medical practice.

events.title: 阿卡德医学泥板传统
events.title_en: The Akkadian medical-tablet tradition
events.summary: 约公元前1900–1600年阿卡德医学泥板流传，后多以亚述巴尼拔图书馆抄本形式保存，含诊断、咒语与药物处方。
events.summary_en: Akkadian medical tablets circulated about 1900–1600 BCE and were later often preserved as copies from Ashurbanipal’s library. They include diagnoses, incantations, and drug prescriptions.
events.material: 含诊断、咒语与药物处方的阿卡德医学泥板
events.material_en: Akkadian medical tablets containing diagnoses, incantations, and drug prescriptions

events.title: 伊尹制汤液（传说）
events.title_en: Yi Yin prepares decoctions (legend)
events.summary: 传统将汤液（煎剂）发明归于商初伊尹。此为传说，反映早期食药与煎煮疗法的文化记忆，精确年代不可考。
events.summary_en: Tradition attributes the invention of decoctions (tangye) to Yi Yin at the start of the Shang. This is a legend. It reflects a cultural memory of early food-medicine and boiling therapy; a precise date cannot be established.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 埃德温·史密斯外科纸草
events.title_en: Edwin Smith Surgical Papyrus
events.summary: 约公元前1600年的埃德温·史密斯纸草记载48例创伤病例，强调观察与预后，巫术成分极少，被视为最早的系统创伤外科文献。
events.summary_en: The Edwin Smith Papyrus, about 1600 BCE, records 48 trauma cases. It emphasizes observation and prognosis and contains very little magic. It is regarded as the earliest systematic trauma-surgery text.
events.material: 记载48例创伤病例的外科纸草
events.material_en: A surgical papyrus recording 48 trauma cases

events.title: 埃伯斯纸草药方集
events.title_en: Ebers Papyrus collection of remedies
events.summary: 约公元前1550年的埃伯斯纸草长达约20米，收载近八百余条处方与内科知识，兼含巫术与经验用药，是古埃及本草与内科的重要资料。
events.summary_en: The Ebers Papyrus, about 1550 BCE, is roughly 20 meters long and contains nearly eight hundred prescriptions and internal-medicine material, mixing magic with empirical drugs. It is a major source for ancient Egyptian materia medica and internal medicine.
events.material: 长约20米、收载近八百余条处方与内科知识的纸草
events.material_en: A papyrus about 20 meters long, containing nearly eight hundred prescriptions and internal-medicine material

events.title: 赫斯特医学纸草
events.title_en: Hearst Medical Papyrus
events.summary: 约公元前1450年的赫斯特纸草为又一古埃及医学文本，内容与埃伯斯纸草部分重叠，反映新王国时期医学抄本传统。
events.summary_en: The Hearst Papyrus, about 1450 BCE, is another ancient Egyptian medical text. Its contents partly overlap the Ebers Papyrus and reflect the copying tradition of the New Kingdom.
events.material: 与埃伯斯纸草部分重叠的古埃及医学纸草
events.material_en: An ancient Egyptian medical papyrus whose contents partly overlap the Ebers Papyrus
events.repository: 加州大学伯克利分校班克罗夫特图书馆
events.repository_en: Bancroft Library, University of California, Berkeley

events.title: 布鲁格施与伦敦医学纸草
events.title_en: Brugsch Papyrus and London Medical Papyrus
events.summary: 约公元前1300年前后的布鲁格施纸草与伦敦医学纸草继续丰富埃及医学文献库，涵盖内科与巫术—医疗混合实践。
events.summary_en: The Brugsch Papyrus and the London Medical Papyrus, from around 1300 BCE, further enlarge the Egyptian medical corpus. They cover internal medicine and mixed magical-medical practice.
events.material: 布鲁格施纸草与伦敦医学纸草
events.material_en: The Brugsch Papyrus and the London Medical Papyrus

events.title: 商代甲骨文疾病记载
events.title_en: Shang oracle-bone records of disease
events.summary: 殷墟甲骨（约前13–前11世纪）大量卜问疾首、疾目、疾腹等，反映疾病认知与巫术—祭祀诊疗并存，是中国最早的疾病文字记录。
events.summary_en: Oracle bones from Yinxu (about the 13th–11th centuries BCE) contain many divinations about illness of the head, eyes, abdomen, and similar complaints. They show disease concepts existing alongside magical and sacrificial treatment, and they are the earliest Chinese written records of illness.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine
events.material: 卜问疾首、疾目、疾腹等的甲骨
events.material_en: Oracle bones used to divine illness of the head, eyes, abdomen, and similar complaints

events.title: 《尚书》药弗瞑眩
events.title_en: The Shangshu line “if the drug does not dizzy, the illness will not be cured”
events.summary: 《尚书·说命》有“若药弗瞑眩，厥疾弗瘳”之语，常被引为早期药力观念的文献证据（文本年代有讨论）。
events.summary_en: The “Charge to Yue” in the Shangshu says that if a drug does not cause dizziness, the illness will not be cured. The line is often cited as early written evidence of ideas about drug potency. The date of the text is debated.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 西周医官分科（食疾疡兽）
events.title_en: Western Zhou medical offices (diet, internal medicine, ulcers, veterinary care)
events.summary: 据《周礼》记载，西周设食医、疾医、疡医、兽医等职，体现早期宫廷医疗的行政分科。成书年代与西周实况需区分。
events.summary_en: According to the Zhouli, the Western Zhou established offices for dietetic physicians, physicians of internal disease, ulcer physicians, and veterinarians, an early administrative division of court medicine. The date of the book and the actual Western Zhou situation should be kept distinct.
sources: 中国政府中医药白皮书
sources_en: Chinese government white paper on traditional Chinese medicine
National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 克尼多斯与科斯医校
events.title_en: Medical schools of Cnidus and Cos
events.summary: 约公元前7世纪起，希腊克尼多斯与科斯等地形成医学教学传统，为希波克拉底学派提供制度与知识背景。
events.summary_en: From about the 7th century BCE, medical teaching traditions formed at Cnidus, Cos, and other Greek sites. They supplied the institutional and intellectual background of the Hippocratic school.

events.title: 医和“六气致病”说
events.title_en: Yi He’s theory of the six qi as causes of disease
events.summary: 公元前541年，秦医医和提出阴、阳、风、雨、晦、明“六气”致病说，见于《左传》，是早期病因理论的重要文献节点。
events.summary_en: In 541 BCE the Qin physician Yi He proposed that disease is caused by the six qi: yin, yang, wind, rain, darkness, and brightness. The account is in the Zuozhuan and is an important early text in etiology.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 扁鹊与四诊传统
events.title_en: Bian Que and the four examinations
events.summary: 战国名医扁鹊（秦越人）被后世与望闻问切四诊及脉学传统联系；《史记》载其“六不治”。生平含传说成分，约前5世纪活动。
events.summary_en: The Warring States physician Bian Que (Qin Yueren) was later linked to the four examinations—inspection, listening and smelling, inquiry, and palpation—and to pulse study. The Shiji records his “six cases not to treat.” His biography includes legend; he was active about the 5th century BCE.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 阿斯克勒庇俄斯神庙医疗
events.title_en: Healing at temples of Asclepius
events.summary: 约公元前5世纪起，希腊各地阿斯克勒庇俄斯神庙（Asklepieion）以孵梦疗法、仪式与经验护理并行，是宗教—医疗复合机构的代表。
events.summary_en: From about the 5th century BCE, Asklepieia across the Greek world combined incubation, ritual, and empirical care. They are a type case of a religious-medical institution.

events.title: 克罗托内的阿尔克迈翁
events.title_en: Alcmaeon of Croton
events.summary: 阿尔克迈翁（约前510–前430）进行早期解剖观察，区分动静脉，主张脑为感觉与理智所在，被誉为希腊理性医学先驱之一。
events.summary_en: Alcmaeon (about 510–430 BCE) made early anatomical observations, distinguished arteries from veins, and held that the brain is the seat of sensation and intellect. He is regarded as one of the pioneers of Greek rational medicine.

events.title: 恩培多克勒四元素说
events.title_en: Empedocles and the four elements
events.summary: 恩培多克勒提出水火气土四元素，后与体液论结合，深刻影响古希腊至中世纪的病理解释框架。
events.summary_en: Empedocles proposed the four elements—water, fire, air, and earth. Combined later with humoral theory, they deeply shaped explanations of disease from ancient Greece through the Middle Ages.

events.title: 希波克拉底出生（约）
events.title_en: Birth of Hippocrates (approximate)
events.summary: 科斯岛的希波克拉底（约前460–前370）被尊为“医学之父”，主张疾病有自然原因，反对纯粹神罚解释。
events.summary_en: Hippocrates of Cos (about 460–370 BCE) is honored as the “father of medicine.” He held that disease has natural causes and rejected purely divine punishment as an explanation.

events.title: 希波克拉底传统与誓词
events.title_en: Hippocratic tradition and the Oath
events.summary: 约公元前420年前后，希波克拉底学派强调观察、预后与自然病因；《希波克拉底誓词》成为后世医德文本原型。相关著作汇为《希波克拉底全集》。
events.summary_en: Around 420 BCE the Hippocratic school emphasized observation, prognosis, and natural causes of disease. The Hippocratic Oath became the prototype of later medical ethics. The related writings were gathered as the Hippocratic Corpus.

events.title: 卡里斯托斯的狄奥克勒斯
events.title_en: Diocles of Carystus
events.summary: 狄奥克勒斯（约前375–前295）著生理学与饮食著作，被誉为“第二希波克拉底”，代表希波克拉底后雅典医学。
events.summary_en: Diocles (about 375–295 BCE) wrote on physiology and diet and was called a “second Hippocrates.” He represents Athenian medicine after Hippocrates.

events.title: 普拉萨戈拉斯区分动静脉搏动
events.title_en: Praxagoras distinguishes arteries, veins, and pulsation
events.summary: 公元前4世纪普拉萨戈拉斯区分静脉与动脉，并认识到动脉搏动，推动脉诊与循环观念萌芽。
events.summary_en: In the 4th century BCE Praxagoras distinguished veins from arteries and recognized arterial pulsation, an early step toward pulse study and ideas of circulation.

events.title: 《五十二病方》传统
events.title_en: The Recipes for Fifty-Two Ailments tradition
events.summary: 马王堆所出《五十二病方》约成书于战国晚期，是现存较早的方剂文献，反映经脉学说定型前的经验方药传统。
events.summary_en: Recipes for Fifty-Two Ailments, recovered from Mawangdui, was compiled about the late Warring States. It is one of the earlier surviving formulary texts and reflects an empirical prescription tradition before channel theory had settled into a fixed form.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 希罗菲卢斯亚历山大里亚解剖
events.title_en: Herophilus and Alexandrian dissection
events.summary: 希罗菲卢斯在托勒密王朝支持下进行人体解剖，区分感觉神经与运动神经，研究脑、眼等结构，创立大量解剖术语。
events.summary_en: With Ptolemaic support, Herophilus dissected human bodies, distinguished sensory from motor nerves, studied the brain, the eye, and other structures, and coined a large anatomical vocabulary.

events.title: 埃拉西斯特拉图斯生理学
events.title_en: The physiology of Erasistratus
events.summary: 埃拉西斯特拉图斯研究脑、心与血管系统，区分大脑与小脑，提出较希罗菲卢斯更偏生理学的解释，代表亚历山大里亚医学高峰。
events.summary_en: Erasistratus studied the brain, heart, and vessels, distinguished the cerebrum from the cerebellum, and offered a more physiological account than Herophilus. He represents the high point of Alexandrian medicine.

events.title: 张家山汉简医书入葬
events.title_en: Medical books buried at Zhangjiashan
events.summary: 湖北张家山汉墓（闭于约前186）出土《脉书》《引书》等，与马王堆经脉文献相互印证，呈现西汉早期经脉与导引知识。
events.summary_en: The Zhangjiashan Han tomb in Hubei, closed about 186 BCE, yielded the Maishu (Book of the Mai), the Yinshu (Book of Pulling), and other slips. Together with the Mawangdui channel texts, they show early Western Han knowledge of channels and daoyin.
events.material_en: Han slips including the Maishu (Book of the Mai) and the Yinshu (Book of Pulling)

events.title: 马王堆三号墓医书封印
events.title_en: Medical manuscripts sealed in Mawangdui tomb 3
events.summary: 长沙马王堆三号汉墓（前168年下葬）出土《足臂十一脉灸经》《阴阳十一脉灸经》《五十二病方》等帛书简牍，是早期经脉与方药的关键考古证据。
events.summary_en: Mawangdui tomb 3 in Changsha, buried in 168 BCE, yielded silk and bamboo texts including the Cauterization Canon of the Eleven Vessels of the Foot and Forearm, the Cauterization Canon of the Eleven Yin-Yang Vessels, and Recipes for Fifty-Two Ailments. They are key archaeological evidence for early channel theory and formulary medicine.
works_en: Cauterization Canon of the Eleven Vessels of the Foot and Forearm
Cauterization Canon of the Eleven Yin-Yang Vessels
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine
events.material: 《足臂十一脉灸经》《阴阳十一脉灸经》《五十二病方》等帛书简牍
events.material_en: Silk and bamboo texts including the two Cauterization Canons of the Eleven Vessels and Recipes for Fifty-Two Ailments
events.address: 湖南省长沙市开福区东风路50号
events.address_en: 50 Dongfeng Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan, China

events.title: 淳于意“诊籍”
events.title_en: Chunyu Yi’s consultation records
events.summary: 西汉太仓公淳于意约前180–前150年间创用“诊籍”（病案记录），《史记》载其二十五案，是早期中医病案传统的重要证据。
events.summary_en: Chunyu Yi, the Taicang Duke of the Western Han, began keeping “consultation records” (case notes) about 180–150 BCE. The Shiji preserves twenty-five of his cases, important evidence for the early Chinese case-history tradition.
sources_en: Shiji, biography of Bian Que and the Duke of Taicang
National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 老官山（天回）医简与漆人
events.title_en: Laoguanshan (Tianhui) medical slips and lacquer figurine
events.summary: 成都天回镇老官山M3（约前157–前141）出土大量医简与彩绘经络漆人，反映西汉早期多元经脉模型与方书传统。
events.summary_en: Laoguanshan tomb M3 at Tianhui in Chengdu (about 157–141 BCE) yielded a large set of medical slips and a lacquer figurine painted with channels. They reflect the plural channel models and formulary tradition of the early Western Han.
events.material_en: Medical slips and a lacquer figurine painted with channels
events.repository_en: Chengdu Institute of Cultural Relics and Archaeology

events.title: 张骞通西域与药物交流
events.title_en: Zhang Qian’s missions to the Western Regions and the exchange of drugs
events.summary: 张骞两次出使西域（前138、前119），传统认为促进葡萄、苜蓿等物种及药物知识交流，丰富本草来源。
events.summary_en: Zhang Qian’s two missions to the Western Regions (138 and 119 BCE) are traditionally credited with promoting the exchange of species such as grapes and alfalfa, and of drug knowledge, which broadened the sources of the materia medica.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 双包山经络漆人
events.title_en: Shuangbaoshan lacquer figurine with channels
events.summary: 四川绵阳双包山汉墓（约前118）出土黑漆人体模型，绘红色经脉线，是已知较早的三维经络模型之一，或兼养生与医疗含义。
events.summary_en: The Shuangbaoshan Han tomb in Mianyang, Sichuan (about 118 BCE), yielded a black-lacquer human model painted with red channel lines. It is one of the earlier known three-dimensional channel models and may have served both cultivation and medical purposes.
events.material: 绘有红色经脉线的黑漆人体模型
events.material_en: A black-lacquer human model painted with red channel lines

events.title: 满城汉墓金银针
events.title_en: Gold and silver needles from the Mancheng Han tomb
events.summary: 河北满城中山靖王墓（前113）出土金银针具；其功能或兼及玉衣缝合与医疗，是否等同后世针灸针仍有讨论。
events.summary_en: The tomb of the Prince of Zhongshan at Mancheng, Hebei (113 BCE), yielded gold and silver needles. They may have been used both to sew jade burial suits and for medical purposes. Whether they are the same as later acupuncture needles is still debated.
events.foundSite_en: Tomb of the Prince of Zhongshan, Mancheng, Hebei
events.material: 金银针具（是否等同后世针灸针仍有讨论）
events.material_en: Gold and silver needles (whether they are the same as later acupuncture needles is still debated)
events.address: 河北省石家庄市长安区东大街4号
events.address_en: 4 Dong Dajie, Chang'an District, Shijiazhuang, Hebei, China

events.title: 《黄帝内经》理论体系成型
events.title_en: The theoretical system of the Huangdi Neijing takes shape
events.summary: 《黄帝内经》（素问、灵枢）主体约战国至秦汉间迭经编订，奠定阴阳五行、脏腑经络、治未病等中医理论框架；非一人一时之作。
events.summary_en: The main text of the Huangdi Neijing (Suwen and Lingshu) was compiled and revised between the Warring States and the Qin–Han period. It established the framework of yin-yang and the five phases, zang-fu and channels, and treating disease before it arises. It is not the work of one person at one time.
works_en: Huangdi Neijing (Inner Canon of the Yellow Emperor)
sources: 世界记忆名录申报材料
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine
Memory of the World nomination materials

events.title: 比提尼亚的阿斯克勒皮亚德斯
events.title_en: Asclepiades of Bithynia
events.summary: 阿斯克勒皮亚德斯（约前124–前44）在罗马传播原子论式医学，强调饮食、运动与温和疗法，反对过度放血。
events.summary_en: Asclepiades (about 124–44 BCE) spread an atomistic style of medicine in Rome. He emphasized diet, exercise, and gentle therapy, and he opposed excessive bloodletting.

events.title: 《难经》问世（约）
events.title_en: Appearance of the Nanjing (approximate)
events.summary: 《黄帝八十一难经》约成于西汉，以问难形式阐发《内经》，强调寸口脉诊并记载脏器度量，对脉学影响深远。
events.summary_en: The Huangdi Bashiyi Nanjing was compiled about the Western Han. In a question-and-answer form it develops the Neijing, stresses cunkou pulse diagnosis, and records measurements of the organs. Its influence on pulse study was lasting.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 武威汉代医简
events.title_en: Wuwei Han medical slips
events.summary: 甘肃武威旱滩坡等地出土东汉医简，载临床方药与针刺内容，补充河西地区汉代医疗实践。
events.summary_en: Eastern Han medical slips unearthed at Hantanpo and related sites in Wuwei, Gansu, record clinical formulas and needling. They supplement the picture of Han medical practice in the Hexi region.
sources_en: studies of the Wuwei medical slips
events.foundSite_en: Hantanpo and related sites, Wuwei, Gansu
events.material: 载临床方药与针刺内容的东汉医简
events.material_en: Eastern Han medical slips recording clinical formulas and needling

events.title: 瓦罗雏形“病菌”观念
events.title_en: Varro’s prototype of a “germ” idea
events.summary: 罗马学者瓦罗（前116–前27）提出沼泽中不可见微粒可致病的设想，常被视为雏形的传染病因假说。
events.summary_en: The Roman scholar Varro (116–27 BCE) suggested that invisible particles in swamps could cause disease. The suggestion is often treated as a prototype of a contagion hypothesis.

events.title: 塞尔苏斯《论医学》
events.title_en: Celsus, De Medicina
events.summary: 奥卢斯·科尔内利乌斯·塞尔苏斯约于公元1世纪中叶编成拉丁百科式医学著作《论医学》，系统介绍饮食、药物与外科。
events.summary_en: Around the middle of the 1st century CE, Aulus Cornelius Celsus compiled the Latin encyclopedic medical work De Medicina, systematically presenting diet, drugs, and surgery.

events.title: 迪奥斯科里德斯《药物志》
events.title_en: Dioscorides, De Materia Medica
events.summary: 佩达尼乌斯·迪奥斯科里德斯约于公元50–70年写成《药物志》（De Materia Medica），成为此后约1600年欧洲与伊斯兰世界本草标准。
events.summary_en: Pedanius Dioscorides wrote De Materia Medica about 50–70 CE. For about 1,600 years it was the standard herbal of Europe and the Islamic world.

events.title: 老普林尼《自然史》
events.title_en: Pliny the Elder, Natural History
events.summary: 老普林尼（23–79）的《自然史》广收动植矿物药用知识，虽驳杂，却是罗马博物与民间医疗的重要汇编。
events.summary_en: The Natural History of Pliny the Elder (23–79) gathers a wide range of medicinal knowledge about animals, plants, and minerals. It is uneven, but it is an important Roman compilation of natural history and popular medicine.

events.title: 《神农本草经》成书（约）
events.title_en: Compilation of the Shennong Bencao Jing (approximate)
events.summary: 《神农本草经》约成于东汉，载药365种，提出君臣佐使、四气五味与三品分类，奠定中药学理论框架；托名神农。
events.summary_en: The Shennong Bencao Jing was compiled about the Eastern Han. It lists 365 drugs and sets out the sovereign-minister-assistant-envoy scheme, the four qi and five flavors, and the three grades. It established the theoretical frame of Chinese pharmacy. It is attributed to Shennong.
works_en: Shennong Bencao Jing (Divine Farmer's Classic of Materia Medica)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 以弗所的鲁弗斯
events.title_en: Rufus of Ephesus
events.summary: 鲁弗斯约1–2世纪写作解剖与病名学著作，强调解剖对临床的重要性。
events.summary_en: Around the 1st–2nd centuries Rufus wrote on anatomy and disease names, and he stressed the importance of anatomy for clinical practice.

events.title: 以弗所的索拉努斯妇产科学
events.title_en: The gynecology of Soranus of Ephesus
events.summary: 索拉努斯（约98–138）的妇产科学著作代表方法论学派成就，对分娩、婴儿护理有系统论述。
events.summary_en: The gynecological writings of Soranus (about 98–138) represent the Methodic school. They give a systematic account of childbirth and infant care.

events.title: 卡帕多西亚的阿雷泰乌斯
events.title_en: Aretaeus of Cappadocia
events.summary: 阿雷泰乌斯约2世纪以精确临床描述著称，对糖尿病、神经系统疾病等有经典记述。
events.summary_en: Aretaeus, about the 2nd century, is known for precise clinical description. His accounts of diabetes and of diseases of the nervous system became classics.

events.title: 盖伦体系主导古代医学
events.title_en: Galen’s system dominates ancient medicine
events.summary: 帕加马的盖伦（129–约216）结合希波克拉底体液论与解剖生理，服务角斗士与罗马皇帝，其著作主导欧亚医学至文艺复兴。
events.summary_en: Galen of Pergamon (129–about 216) combined Hippocratic humoral theory with anatomy and physiology. He served gladiators and Roman emperors, and his writings dominated Eurasian medicine until the Renaissance.
works: On the Usefulness of the Parts
works_en: On the Usefulness of the Parts

events.title: 华佗麻沸散与五禽戏
events.title_en: Hua Tuo’s mafeisan and the Five-Animal Frolics
events.summary: 华佗（约110–208）传说创麻沸散用于外科并倡导五禽戏导引。其外科麻醉细节难确证，但对后世外科学与养生影响巨大。
events.summary_en: Hua Tuo (about 110–208) is traditionally credited with creating mafeisan for surgery and with promoting the Five-Animal Frolics. The details of his surgical anesthesia are hard to verify, but his influence on later external medicine and cultivation practices was large.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 张仲景《伤寒杂病论》
events.title_en: Zhang Zhongjing, Treatise on Cold Damage and Miscellaneous Diseases
events.summary: 张仲景约于建安末年著《伤寒杂病论》，确立六经辨证与杂病论治，是中医辨证论治体系的奠基之作；原书后析为《伤寒论》《金匮要略》。
events.summary_en: Near the end of the Jian’an era, Zhang Zhongjing wrote the Shanghan Zabing Lun. It established six-channel pattern differentiation and the treatment of miscellaneous diseases, and it is the founding work of Chinese pattern differentiation and treatment. The original was later divided into the Shanghan Lun and the Jingui Yaolue.
works_en: Shanghan Zabing Lun (Treatise on Cold Damage and Miscellaneous Diseases)
Jingui Yaolue (Essential Prescriptions of the Golden Cabinet)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 皇甫谧《针灸甲乙经》
events.title_en: Huangfu Mi, the Zhenjiu Jiayi Jing
events.summary: 皇甫谧约256–260年编成《针灸甲乙经》，系统整理腧穴、经络与刺灸法，是早期针灸学集大成之作。
events.summary_en: About 256–260 Huangfu Mi compiled the Zhenjiu Jiayi Jing. It systematically arranges acupoints, channels, and needling and moxibustion, and it is an early summation of acupuncture and moxibustion.
works_en: Zhenjiu Jiayi Jing (Systematic Classic of Acupuncture and Moxibustion)

events.title: 王叔和《脉经》
events.title_en: Wang Shuhe, the Pulse Classic
events.summary: 西晋王叔和约3世纪著《脉经》，整理寸口脉法与脉象分类，是现存最早的脉学专著，并整订《伤寒论》传本。
events.summary_en: In the Western Jin, about the 3rd century, Wang Shuhe wrote the Maijing. It organizes the cunkou pulse method and the classification of pulse images. It is the earliest surviving monograph on the pulse, and he also edited a transmitted text of the Shanghan Lun.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine
historical notes from Jiangxi University of Chinese Medicine

events.title: 葛洪《肘后备急方》
events.title_en: Ge Hong, Handbook of Prescriptions for Emergencies
events.summary: 葛洪约347年成《肘后备急方》，强调简便廉验救急方，其中青蒿治疟记载启发后世青蒿素研发。
events.summary_en: About 347 Ge Hong completed the Zhouhou Beiji Fang. It emphasizes simple, inexpensive, effective emergency formulas. Its record of qinghao for malaria later inspired the development of artemisinin.
works_en: Zhouhou Beiji Fang (Handbook of Prescriptions for Emergencies)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 奥里巴西乌斯医学百科
events.title_en: The medical encyclopedia of Oribasius
events.summary: 奥里巴西乌斯（约325–400）为尤利安皇帝编纂约70卷医学百科，保存大量盖伦与希腊医学摘录。
events.summary_en: Oribasius (about 325–400) compiled a medical encyclopedia of about 70 books for the emperor Julian, preserving large extracts from Galen and Greek medicine.

events.title: 巴西尔在凯撒利亚建医院
events.title_en: Basil founds a hospital at Caesarea
events.summary: 约369年，凯撒利亚的巴西尔建立含病房、医护与工坊的综合慈善机构Basileias，是基督教医院传统的重要早期范例。
events.summary_en: About 369 Basil of Caesarea established the Basileias, a comprehensive charitable institution with wards, care, and workshops. It is an important early example of the Christian hospital tradition.

events.title: 法比奥拉在罗马建医院
events.title_en: Fabiola founds a hospital in Rome
events.summary: 约400年，罗马贵族法比奥拉创办拉丁基督教世界较早的医院，推动西欧医院慈善模式。
events.summary_en: About 400 the Roman noblewoman Fabiola founded one of the earlier hospitals of Latin Christendom and helped spread the charitable hospital model in western Europe.

events.title: 《雷公炮炙论》
events.title_en: Master Lei’s Treatise on Drug Processing
events.summary: 南朝雷斅所著《雷公炮炙论》（约5世纪）专论药材炮制，是中药炮制学早期专书。
events.summary_en: The Leigong Paozhi Lun, written by Lei Xiao of the Southern Dynasties (about the 5th century), is devoted to the processing of medicinal materials. It is an early specialist book of Chinese drug processing.
works_en: Leigong Paozhi Lun (Master Lei's Treatise on Drug Processing)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 陶弘景《本草经集注》
events.title_en: Tao Hongjing, Collective Commentaries on the Classic of Materia Medica
events.summary: 梁代陶弘景约公元500年前后作《本草经集注》，扩充《神农本草经》并重新分类，成为唐本草前的权威注本。
events.summary_en: Around 500 Tao Hongjing of the Liang wrote the Bencao Jing Jizhu. It expanded the Shennong Bencao Jing and reclassified its drugs, and it was the authoritative commentary before the Tang materia medica.
works_en: Bencao Jing Jizhu (Collective Commentaries on the Classic of Materia Medica)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 阿米达的埃提乌斯医学汇编
events.title_en: The medical compilation of Aetius of Amida
events.summary: 埃提乌斯约于6世纪中叶编成大型医学汇编，分16卷，保存希腊医学外科与妇科内容。
events.summary_en: About the middle of the 6th century Aetius compiled a large medical collection in 16 books, preserving Greek surgical and gynecological material.

events.title: 巢元方《诸病源候论》
events.title_en: Chao Yuanfang, Treatise on the Origins and Symptoms of Diseases
events.summary: 隋太医巢元方610年奉敕编《诸病源候论》，详论病因症候而不列方药，是病因证候学巨著。
events.summary_en: In 610 Chao Yuanfang, an imperial physician of the Sui, compiled the Zhubing Yuanhou Lun by imperial order. It discusses causes and symptom patterns in detail and does not list formulas. It is a major work of etiology and symptomology.
works_en: Zhubing Yuanhou Lun (Treatise on the Origins and Symptoms of Diseases)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 唐太医署医学校
events.title_en: The Tang Imperial Medical Office as a medical school
events.summary: 624年唐代太医署设医学教育，分科培养医师，是古代中国较完备的官方医学教育机构之一。
events.summary_en: In 624 the Tang Imperial Medical Office set up medical education and trained physicians by specialty. It was one of the more complete official medical schools in ancient China.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 埃伊纳的保罗《医学纲要》
events.title_en: Paul of Aegina, Epitome of Medicine
events.summary: 保罗约于7世纪写成7卷本医学百科，外科部分尤为详尽，后被阿布卡西斯等伊斯兰外科家广泛引用。
events.summary_en: About the 7th century Paul wrote a seven-book medical encyclopedia. The surgical part is especially detailed and was widely cited by Islamic surgeons such as Albucasis.

events.title: 孙思邈《千金要方》
events.title_en: Sun Simiao, Essential Prescriptions Worth a Thousand Gold
events.summary: 孙思邈约652年成《备急千金要方》，682年续《千金翼方》；《大医精诚》成为中医医德经典，并强调道地药材。
events.summary_en: About 652 Sun Simiao completed the Beiji Qianjin Yaofang, and in 682 he continued it with the Qianjin Yifang. “On the Absolute Sincerity of Great Physicians” became a classic of Chinese medical ethics, and he also stressed geo-authentic medicinal materials.
works_en: Qianjin Yaofang (Essential Prescriptions Worth a Thousand Gold)
Qianjin Yifang (Supplement to the Prescriptions Worth a Thousand Gold)
On the Absolute Sincerity of Great Physicians
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 《新修本草》（唐本草）
events.title_en: Newly Revised Materia Medica (Tang materia medica)
events.summary: 苏敬等659年奉敕完成《新修本草》，收药844种，是世界上较早由国家颁行的药典性本草。
events.summary_en: In 659 Su Jing and colleagues completed the Xinxiu Bencao by imperial order. It records 844 drugs and is one of the earlier state-issued pharmacopoeial materia medicas.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 《食疗本草》
events.title_en: Materia Medica for Diet Therapy
events.summary: 约713–741年孟诜《食疗本草》系统整理食物药用，体现唐代食疗传统。
events.summary_en: About 713–741 Meng Shen’s Shiliao Bencao systematically arranged the medicinal uses of foods, expressing the Tang tradition of diet therapy.
works_en: Shiliao Bencao (Materia Medica for Diet Therapy)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 贡迪沙普尔医学传统迁入巴格达
events.title_en: The Gundeshapur medical tradition moves to Baghdad
events.summary: 萨珊时期贡迪沙普尔医院与医校传统在阿拔斯朝被引入巴格达，Nestorians与布赫蒂舒家族推动希腊—伊朗—印度医学融合。
events.summary_en: The hospital and medical-school tradition of Gundeshapur from the Sasanian period was brought into Baghdad under the Abbasids. Nestorians and the Bukhtishu family helped fuse Greek, Iranian, and Indian medicine.

events.title: 王焘《外台秘要》
events.title_en: Wang Tao, Arcane Essentials from the Imperial Library
events.summary: 王焘752年编成《外台秘要》，广辑唐以前方书，保存大量已佚文献，是方书文献学宝库。
events.summary_en: In 752 Wang Tao compiled the Waitai Miyao. It widely gathers pre-Tang formula books and preserves a large amount of literature that was later lost. It is a treasury for the study of formula texts.
works_en: Waitai Miyao (Arcane Essentials from the Imperial Library)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 鉴真东渡传医学
events.title_en: Jianzhen travels east and transmits medicine
events.summary: 鉴真和尚东渡日本，携带并传授医药知识，促进中日医学交流。
events.summary_en: The monk Jianzhen crossed to Japan, carrying and teaching medical knowledge and promoting medical exchange between China and Japan.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 王冰次注《黄帝内经素问》
events.title_en: Wang Bing’s edition and commentary on the Suwen
events.summary: 唐王冰约762年重次注释《素问》，补入七篇大论，定型后世通行本《素问》结构。
events.summary_en: About 762 the Tang scholar Wang Bing re-edited and commented on the Suwen. He added the seven great discourses and fixed the structure of the Suwen text that later circulated.
works_en: Commentary on the Suwen of the Huangdi Neijing
sources_en: historical notes from Jiangxi University of Chinese Medicine

events.title: 巴格达早期比马里斯坦
events.title_en: An early bimaristan in Baghdad
events.summary: 约8世纪末至9世纪初，哈里发哈伦·拉希德时期巴格达建立早期综合医院（比马里斯坦），结合诊疗、教学与研究。
events.summary_en: From the late 8th century into the early 9th, in the time of Caliph Harun al-Rashid, an early general hospital (bimaristan) was established in Baghdad, combining treatment, teaching, and study.

events.title: 《理伤续断方》
events.title_en: Formulas for Treating Injuries and Restoring Continuity
events.summary: 约841–845年蔺道人《理伤续断方》专论骨折伤科，是中医骨伤科重要早期专书。
events.summary_en: About 841–845 Lin Daoren’s Lishang Xuduan Fang specialized in fractures and traumatology. It is an important early specialist book of Chinese traumatology.
works_en: Lishang Xuduan Fang (Formulas for Treating Injuries and Restoring Continuity)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 侯奈因·伊本·伊斯哈格翻译运动
events.title_en: The translation movement of Hunayn ibn Ishaq
events.summary: 侯奈因（约830–873）等将大量盖伦与希腊医学著作译为叙利亚语与阿拉伯语，奠定伊斯兰医学文献基础。
events.summary_en: Hunayn (about 830–873) and others translated a large body of Galen and Greek medicine into Syriac and Arabic, laying the textual foundation of Islamic medicine.

events.title: 萨勒诺医学校兴起
events.title_en: Rise of the medical school of Salerno
events.summary: 约9世纪围绕本笃会医院发展的萨勒诺医学校，10–12世纪达于鼎盛，融合希腊、拉丁、阿拉伯与犹太医学，是西欧最早的医学校之一。
events.summary_en: The medical school of Salerno grew up around a Benedictine hospital about the 9th century and reached its height in the 10th–12th centuries. It fused Greek, Latin, Arabic, and Jewish medicine and was one of the earliest medical schools in western Europe.

events.title: 金迪论药物等级
events.title_en: Al-Kindi on the degrees of drugs
events.summary: 哲学家金迪著《论等级》（De Gradibus），尝试量化药物效力，影响中世纪药理学讨论。
events.summary_en: The philosopher al-Kindi wrote De Gradibus, an attempt to quantify drug potency that influenced medieval pharmacological discussion.

events.title: 图伦王朝开罗医院（瓦克夫资助）
events.title_en: The Tulunid hospital in Cairo, funded by a waqf
events.summary: 艾哈迈德·伊本·图伦在开罗建立医院并以瓦克夫（宗教基金）资助，使医院财务制度更可持续，是伊斯兰医院发展的里程碑。
events.summary_en: Ahmad ibn Tulun founded a hospital in Cairo and endowed it with a waqf, making hospital finance more sustainable. It was a milestone in the development of Islamic hospitals.

events.title: 拉齐区分天花与麻疹
events.title_en: Al-Razi distinguishes smallpox from measles
events.summary: 拉齐（Rhazes，约865–925）在《全书》等著作中清晰区分天花与麻疹，并开创儿科专论传统，是临床观察的典范。
events.summary_en: Al-Razi (Rhazes, about 865–925) clearly distinguished smallpox from measles in the Comprehensive Book and other works, and he opened a tradition of specialist pediatric writing. The distinction is a model of clinical observation.

events.title: 《开宝本草》
events.title_en: Kaibao Materia Medica
events.summary: 宋初973年官修《开宝重定本草》，继承唐本草并增补，开启宋代官修本草传统。
events.summary_en: In 973, early in the Song, the state compiled the Kaibao Revised Materia Medica. It inherited the Tang materia medica and added to it, opening the Song tradition of official materia medica.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 巴格达阿杜德医院
events.title_en: The Adudi Hospital in Baghdad
events.summary: 约980年建立的阿杜德（ʿAḍudī）医院规模宏大，设专科与教学，代表阿拔斯晚期医院高峰，1258年蒙古攻陷巴格达后毁。
events.summary_en: The Adudi Hospital, founded about 980, was very large, with specialties and teaching. It represents the late Abbasid peak of the hospital. It was destroyed after the Mongol capture of Baghdad in 1258.

events.title: 马朱西《王书》
events.title_en: Al-Majusi, The Complete Book of the Medical Art
events.summary: 阿里·伊本·阿巴斯·马朱西（Haly Abbas）著《医学全书》（Liber Regius），结构清晰，经拉丁译本影响萨勒诺与欧洲课程。
events.summary_en: Ali ibn al-Abbas al-Majusi (Haly Abbas) wrote The Complete Book of the Medical Art (Liber Regius). Its clear structure, through Latin translation, influenced the curriculum at Salerno and in Europe.

events.title: 《太平圣惠方》
events.title_en: Taiping Holy Prescriptions
events.summary: 王怀隐等992年奉敕编成《太平圣惠方》，大型官修方书，反映北宋初方药水平。
events.summary_en: In 992 Wang Huaiyin and colleagues compiled the Taiping Shenghui Fang by imperial order. It is a large official formulary and reflects the level of formulas and drugs in the early Northern Song.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 扎赫拉维《医学宝鉴》外科
events.title_en: Al-Zahrawi’s surgery in the Kitab al-Tasrif
events.summary: 扎赫拉威（Albucasis，约936–1013）的《医学宝鉴》（Al-Tasrif）详述手术器械与术式，将外科提升至医学核心地位，深刻影响欧洲外科。
events.summary_en: The Kitab al-Tasrif of al-Zahrawi (Albucasis, about 936–1013) describes surgical instruments and procedures in detail, raised surgery to a central place in medicine, and deeply influenced European surgery.

events.title: 伊本·西那《医典》
events.title_en: Ibn Sina, The Canon of Medicine
events.summary: 伊本·西那（阿维森纳，980–1037）约于1025年前后完成《医典》，综合盖伦与临床经验，成为伊斯兰与欧洲大学标准教材至18世纪。
events.summary_en: Ibn Sina (Avicenna, 980–1037) completed The Canon of Medicine around 1025. It synthesized Galen and clinical experience and was a standard textbook in Islamic and European universities until the 18th century.

events.title: 王惟一针灸铜人
events.title_en: Wang Weiyi’s acupuncture bronze figure
events.summary: 王惟一1026年著《铜人腧穴针灸图经》，次年铸针灸铜人，供教学考试，是针灸标准化的里程碑。
events.summary_en: In 1026 Wang Weiyi wrote the Illustrated Canon of Acupoints on the Bronze Figure, and the next year he cast an acupuncture bronze figure for teaching and examination. It was a milestone in the standardization of acupuncture.
works_en: Illustrated Canon of Acupoints on the Bronze Figure
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 《欧希范五脏图》《存真图》
events.title_en: Ou Xifan’s Charts of the Five Viscera and the Cunzhen Tu
events.summary: 北宋出现基于刑尸观察的《欧希范五脏图》与杨介《存真图》，是中国古代解剖学的重要图像文献。
events.summary_en: In the Northern Song, Ou Xifan’s Charts of the Five Viscera and Yang Jie’s Cunzhen Tu, based on observation of executed bodies, became important illustrated documents of anatomy in ancient China.
works_en: Ou Xifan's Charts of the Five Viscera
Cunzhen Tu (Charts for Preserving the True)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 校正医书局
events.title_en: Bureau for Editing Medical Books
events.summary: 1057年北宋设校正医书局，系统校刻《伤寒论》《千金方》等经典，深刻影响医书传本与医学教育。
events.summary_en: In 1057 the Northern Song established the Bureau for Editing Medical Books. It systematically collated and printed the Shanghan Lun, the Qianjin Fang, and other classics, deeply affecting transmitted texts and medical education.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine
historical notes from Jiangxi University of Chinese Medicine

events.title: 非洲人康斯坦丁翻译阿拉伯医书
events.title_en: Constantine the African translates Arabic medical books
events.summary: 康斯坦丁（卒约1087）将大量阿拉伯医学著作译为拉丁文并引入萨勒诺，使盖伦—伊斯兰医学进入拉丁欧洲课程。
events.summary_en: Constantine (died about 1087) translated a large body of Arabic medicine into Latin and brought it to Salerno, so that Galenic-Islamic medicine entered the Latin European curriculum.

events.title: 太医局卖药所
events.title_en: The Imperial Medical Bureau’s drug-selling office
events.summary: 1076年官办太医局设卖药所（后发展为和剂局），推行官药与成药，体现国家医药供应制度化。
events.summary_en: In 1076 the official Imperial Medical Bureau set up a drug-selling office, later developed into the Imperial Pharmacy. It promoted official drugs and prepared medicines and shows the institutionalization of state drug supply.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 唐慎微《证类本草》
events.title_en: Tang Shenwei, Classified Materia Medica
events.summary: 唐慎微约1082年成《经史证类备急本草》，集宋以前本草大成，李时珍《纲目》多本于此。
events.summary_en: About 1082 Tang Shenwei completed the Classified Materia Medica from Historical Classics for Emergencies. It summed up the pre-Song materia medica, and Li Shizhen’s Compendium drew heavily on it.
works_en: Classified Materia Medica from Historical Classics for Emergencies
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 特罗图拉与萨勒诺妇科传统
events.title_en: Trotula and the Salernitan gynecological tradition
events.summary: 托名或相关的《特罗图拉》文集约于11–12世纪在萨勒诺形成，是中世纪欧洲重要的妇科与妇女健康文献。
events.summary_en: The Trotula ensemble, attributed or related to Trotula, took shape at Salerno in the 11th–12th centuries. It is an important medieval European text on gynecology and women’s health.

events.title: 钱乙《小儿药证直诀》
events.title_en: Qian Yi, Key to Diagnosis and Treatment of Children’s Diseases
events.summary: 钱乙儿科经验由其弟子阎孝忠约1114年整理为《小儿药证直诀》，创立小儿五脏辨证，被誉为儿科之圣。
events.summary_en: Qian Yi’s pediatric experience was arranged about 1114 by his disciple Yan Xiaozhong as the Xiao’er Yaozheng Zhijue. It established five-zang pattern differentiation for children, and Qian Yi is honored as a sage of pediatrics.
works_en: Xiao'er Yaozheng Zhijue (Key to Therapeutics and Patterns in Children)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 寇宗奭《本草衍义》
events.title_en: Kou Zongshi, Extension of the Materia Medica
events.summary: 寇宗奭约1116年著《本草衍义》，强调鉴别与药性辨析，补充《证类本草》。
events.summary_en: About 1116 Kou Zongshi wrote the Bencao Yanyi. It stresses identification and the analysis of drug properties and supplements the Classified Materia Medica.
works_en: Bencao Yanyi (Extension of the Materia Medica)

events.title: 《圣济总录》
events.title_en: Comprehensive Recording of Sage-like Benefaction
events.summary: 政和年间官修《圣济总录》（约1117），超200卷，是宋代最大型医学全书之一。
events.summary_en: The Shengji Zonglu, an official compilation of the Zhenghe era (about 1117), runs to more than 200 volumes and is one of the largest medical compendia of the Song.
works_en: Shengji Zonglu (Comprehensive Recording of Sage-like Benefaction)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 伦敦圣巴塞洛缪医院创办
events.title_en: Founding of St Bartholomew’s Hospital, London
events.summary: 1123年宫廷弄臣拉赫尔创办圣巴塞洛缪医院，是英格兰持续运作最久的医院之一，早期亦收治精神患者。
events.summary_en: In 1123 the courtier Rahere founded St Bartholomew’s Hospital. It is one of the longest continuously operating hospitals in England, and in its early years it also received patients with mental illness.

events.title: 许叔微伤寒著作
events.title_en: Xu Shuwei’s writings on cold damage
events.summary: 许叔微南宋初年著《伤寒百证歌》等，推动《伤寒论》歌赋化与临床普及。
events.summary_en: In the early Southern Song, Xu Shuwei wrote Songs of a Hundred Cold-Damage Patterns and other works, helping to turn the Shanghan Lun into verse and to spread it in clinical practice.
works_en: Songs of a Hundred Cold-Damage Patterns

events.title: 伊本·祖赫尔（阿文佐亚）
events.title_en: Ibn Zuhr (Avenzoar)
events.summary: 伊本·祖赫尔（Avenzoar，约1090–1162）强调实验观察与外科，是阿维罗伊之师，代表安达卢斯临床医学高峰。
events.summary_en: Ibn Zuhr (Avenzoar, about 1090–1162) emphasized experimental observation and surgery. He was Averroes’s teacher and represents a high point of clinical medicine in al-Andalus.

events.title: 《太平惠民和剂局方》
events.title_en: Formulary of the Taiping Imperial Pharmacy
events.summary: 1151年定本《太平惠民和剂局方》推广官药成方，影响东亚配方传统，亦因“局方滥用”遭金元医家批评。
events.summary_en: The 1151 standard text of the Taiping Huimin Heji Jufang spread official prepared formulas. It influenced the East Asian formula tradition and was also criticized by Jin-Yuan physicians for overuse of the pharmacy’s formulas.
works_en: Taiping Huimin Heji Jufang (Formulary of the Taiping Imperial Pharmacy)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 大马士革努里医院
events.title_en: The Nuri Hospital in Damascus
events.summary: 努尔丁约于1154–1160年创办大马士革努里医院，兼作医校，患者免费获药与食，病历管理先进，建筑部分存留至今。
events.summary_en: About 1154–1160 Nur al-Din founded the Nuri Hospital in Damascus. It also served as a medical school. Patients received drugs and food free of charge, case records were advanced, and part of the building survives.

events.title: 阿维罗伊医学与哲学
events.title_en: Averroes on medicine and philosophy
events.summary: 伊本·鲁世德（Averroes，1126–1198）注释亚里士多德并撰写医学著作，影响拉丁经院医学哲学讨论。
events.summary_en: Ibn Rushd (Averroes, 1126–1198) commented on Aristotle and wrote medical works. He influenced Latin scholastic discussion of medical philosophy.

events.title: 罗杰《外科学》
events.title_en: Roger of Salerno, Surgery
events.summary: 萨勒诺的罗杰约于1170年写成《外科学》（Chirurgia），成为中世纪拉丁外科教学的基础文本。
events.summary_en: About 1170 Roger of Salerno wrote the Chirurgia, which became a basic text of medieval Latin surgical teaching.

events.title: 刘完素寒凉学派
events.title_en: Liu Wansu and the cold-and-cool school
events.summary: 金代刘完素（约1110–1200）倡火热病机与寒凉清热，开河间学派，为金元四大家之一。
events.summary_en: Liu Wansu of the Jin (about 1110–1200) advocated fire-heat pathology and cold-cool clearing of heat. He opened the Hejian school and is one of the Four Great Masters of the Jin and Yuan.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 张从正攻下学派
events.title_en: Zhang Congzheng and the attack-and-purge school
events.summary: 张从正（约1150–1228）主张攻邪安正，善用汗吐下，称攻下派，为金元四大家之一。
events.summary_en: Zhang Congzheng (about 1150–1228) held that one should attack pathogenic factors in order to restore the upright qi. He was skilled with sweating, vomiting, and purging. He is called the attack-and-purge master and is one of the Four Great Masters of the Jin and Yuan.
works_en: Rumen Shiqin (Confucians' Duties to Their Parents)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 蒙彼利埃医学大学规章
events.title_en: Statutes of the University of Medicine at Montpellier
events.summary: 蒙彼利埃医学教学12世纪已兴，1220年获正式大学规章，与萨勒诺、巴黎并列为中世纪欧洲医学重镇。
events.summary_en: Medical teaching at Montpellier was already active in the 12th century. In 1220 it received formal university statutes and stood with Salerno and Paris as a major center of medieval European medicine.

events.title: 陈自明《妇人大全良方》
events.title_en: Chen Ziming, Complete Good Formulas for Women
events.summary: 陈自明1237年著《妇人大全良方》，系统总结宋以前妇科，是中医妇科里程碑；后又有《外科精要》。
events.summary_en: In 1237 Chen Ziming wrote the Furen Daquan Liangfang, a systematic summation of pre-Song gynecology and a milestone in Chinese gynecology. He later also wrote Essentials of External Medicine.
works_en: Furen Daquan Liangfang (Complete Good Formulas for Women)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 李东垣补土学派
events.title_en: Li Dongyuan and the earth-supplementing school
events.summary: 李杲（东垣，约1180–1251）著《脾胃论》，倡内伤脾胃学说与甘温除热，开创补土派。
events.summary_en: Li Gao (Dongyuan, about 1180–1251) wrote the Treatise on the Spleen and Stomach. He advocated the doctrine of internal damage to the spleen and stomach and the sweet-warm method of clearing heat, and he founded the earth-supplementing school.
works_en: Piwei Lun (Treatise on the Spleen and Stomach)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 伊本·纳菲斯肺循环学说
events.title_en: Ibn al-Nafis on the pulmonary circulation
events.summary: 伊本·纳菲斯提出右心室与左心室分隔，描述肺循环与冠状循环，挑战盖伦多孔中隔说，早于欧洲同类认识数百年。
events.summary_en: Ibn al-Nafis argued that the right and left ventricles are separated, and he described the pulmonary circulation and the coronary circulation. He challenged Galen’s porous septum centuries before comparable European accounts.

events.title: 宋慈《洗冤集录》
events.title_en: Song Ci, Collected Cases of Injustice Rectified
events.summary: 宋慈1247年著《洗冤集录》，是世界最早系统法医学专著之一，详述尸检与伤害鉴定。
events.summary_en: In 1247 Song Ci wrote the Xiyuan Jilu, one of the world’s earliest systematic works of forensic medicine. It describes autopsy and the assessment of injuries in detail.
works_en: Xiyuan Jilu (Collected Cases of Injustice Rectified)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 伊本·拜塔尔本草
events.title_en: Ibn al-Baytar’s materia medica
events.summary: 伊本·拜塔尔约1248年完成大型本草与药学著作，广收地中海与东方药物，是中世纪药学集大成者之一。
events.summary_en: About 1248 Ibn al-Baytar completed a large work of materia medica and pharmacy. It gathers Mediterranean and eastern drugs and is one of the medieval summations of pharmacy.

events.title: 开罗曼苏里医院
events.title_en: The Mansuri Hospital in Cairo
events.summary: 1284年开罗曼苏里医院落成，规模巨大、分科齐全，是马穆鲁克时期伊斯兰医院的典范。
events.summary_en: The Mansuri Hospital in Cairo was completed in 1284. It was huge and fully divided into specialties, a model Islamic hospital of the Mamluk period.

events.title: 凸透镜眼镜矫正远视
events.title_en: Convex spectacles for farsightedness
events.summary: 约13世纪末意大利出现凸透镜眼镜治疗远视，是光学辅助医疗的重要发明。
events.summary_en: In the late 13th century convex-lens spectacles for farsightedness appeared in Italy, an important invention in optical aids to medicine.

events.title: 佛罗伦萨新圣母医院
events.title_en: Santa Maria Nuova in Florence
events.summary: 1288年佛罗伦萨新圣母医院创办，以纯医疗功能著称，成为文艺复兴城市医院样板。
events.summary_en: Santa Maria Nuova in Florence was founded in 1288. It was known for a purely medical function and became a model Renaissance civic hospital.

events.title: 蒙迪诺《解剖学》与公开解剖
events.title_en: Mondino’s Anathomia and public dissection
events.summary: 博洛尼亚的蒙迪诺约于1315年公开解剖人体，1316年著《解剖学》，恢复系统性人体解剖教学，影响文艺复兴解剖。
events.summary_en: About 1315 Mondino de’ Luzzi of Bologna publicly dissected a human body, and in 1316 he wrote the Anathomia. He restored systematic teaching of human anatomy and influenced Renaissance anatomy.

events.title: 忽思慧《饮膳正要》
events.title_en: Hu Sihui's Yinshan zhengyao (Proper Essentials of Food and Drink)
events.summary: 元代饮膳太医忽思慧撰成《饮膳正要》，汇集宫廷食疗方、饮食宜忌与养生法，是现存较早的系统营养与食疗专著。
events.summary_en: Hu Sihui, dietary physician at the Yuan court, completed the Yinshan zhengyao, gathering court food-therapy recipes, dietary rules and regimen advice. It is one of the earliest surviving systematic works on nutrition and diet therapy.

events.title: 危亦林《世医得效方》
events.title_en: Wei Yilin's Shiyi dexiao fang
events.summary: 元代危亦林据家传五世医术编成《世医得效方》，骨伤部分记载悬吊复位法治疗脊柱骨折，并用草乌等药物作全身麻醉。
events.summary_en: Wei Yilin of the Yuan dynasty compiled the Shiyi dexiao fang from five generations of family practice. Its bone-setting section describes suspension reduction for spinal fractures and general anaesthesia with drugs such as aconite.

events.title: 朱丹溪滋阴学派
events.title_en: Zhu Danxi and the yin-nourishing school
events.summary: 朱震亨（丹溪，1281–1358）倡“阳常有余，阴常不足”，开创滋阴派，完成金元四大家格局。
events.summary_en: Zhu Zhenheng (Danxi, 1281–1358) taught that “yang is often in excess and yin is often insufficient.” He founded the yin-nourishing school and completed the pattern of the Four Great Masters of the Jin and Yuan.
works_en: Gezhi Yulun (Further Discourses on Extending Knowledge)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 《敖氏伤寒金镜录》舌诊图
events.title_en: Ao’s Golden Mirror of Cold Damage, with tongue charts
events.summary: 约1341年《敖氏伤寒金镜录》载舌象图谱，推动舌诊可视化与教学。
events.summary_en: About 1341 Ao’s Golden Mirror of Cold Damage included charts of the tongue, which helped make tongue diagnosis visible and teachable.
works_en: Ao's Golden Mirror of Cold Damage
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 滑寿《十四经发挥》
events.title_en: Hua Shou's Shisi jing fahui (Elucidation of the Fourteen Channels)
events.summary: 滑寿把任、督二脉与十二经并称“十四经”，逐经考订循行与腧穴，对后世经络腧穴学影响深远。
events.summary_en: Hua Shou grouped the Ren and Du vessels with the twelve regular channels as the 'fourteen channels', checking each pathway and its points. The book shaped later channel and acupoint studies.

events.title: 居伊·德·肖利亚克《大外科学》
events.title_en: Guy de Chauliac, Great Surgery
events.summary: 教皇医师居伊·德·肖利亚克约于1363年完成《大外科学》，综合阿拉伯与拉丁外科，主导晚期中世纪外科实践。
events.summary_en: About 1363 Guy de Chauliac, physician to the pope, completed the Great Surgery. It synthesized Arabic and Latin surgery and dominated late medieval surgical practice.

events.title: 约翰·阿德恩肛瘘手术
events.title_en: John of Arderne’s operation for anal fistula
events.summary: 英格兰外科医生约翰·阿德恩约14世纪以肛瘘手术闻名，留下详细手术记录，代表中世纪外科专业化。
events.summary_en: The English surgeon John of Arderne, about the 14th century, was famous for operating on anal fistula and left detailed operative records. He represents the professionalization of medieval surgery.

events.title: 《普济方》成书
events.title_en: Completion of the Puji Fang
events.summary: 明永乐年间《普济方》成书，卷帙浩繁，是中国古代最大型方书之一。
events.summary_en: The Puji Fang was completed in the Yongle reign of the Ming. It is enormous in bulk and is one of the largest formula books of ancient China.
sources_en: historical notes from Jiangxi University of Chinese Medicine

events.title: 朱橚《救荒本草》
events.title_en: Zhu Su's Jiuhuang bencao (Famine Relief Herbal)
events.summary: 明周定王朱橚组织栽种观察野生植物，收录可供荒年充饥的植物四百余种并附图，开创以救荒为目的的本草著作。
events.summary_en: Zhu Su, Prince Ding of Zhou, had wild plants grown and observed, and recorded more than 400 species that could be eaten in famine years, each with an illustration. It began a line of herbals written for famine relief.

events.title: 帕拉塞尔苏斯出生
events.title_en: Birth of Paracelsus
events.summary: 帕拉塞尔苏斯1493年出生于瑞士，后以医化学挑战古代权威，象征文艺复兴医学的反叛气质。
events.summary_en: Paracelsus was born in Switzerland in 1493. He later challenged ancient authority with iatrochemistry and came to symbolize the rebellious temper of Renaissance medicine.

events.title: 伦敦皇家内科医师学院特许状
events.title_en: Royal charter of the College of Physicians of London
events.summary: 1518年伦敦内科医师学院获王室特许状，成为英国医师专业自律与资格认定的重要机构。
events.summary_en: In 1518 the College of Physicians of London received a royal charter. It became an important institution for professional self-regulation and qualification of physicians in England.

events.title: 帕拉塞尔苏斯化学医学
events.title_en: Paracelsus and chemical medicine
events.summary: 帕拉塞尔苏斯（1493–1541）公开抵制盖伦与阿维森纳权威，倡导矿物与化学药物，开创医化学传统。
events.summary_en: Paracelsus (1493–1541) publicly rejected the authority of Galen and Avicenna, advocated mineral and chemical drugs, and opened the iatrochemical tradition.

events.title: 维萨里《人体的构造》
events.title_en: Vesalius, De humani corporis fabrica
events.summary: 安德烈亚斯·维萨里1543年出版《人体的构造》，基于亲自解剖纠正盖伦错误，奠定现代人体解剖学。
events.summary_en: In 1543 Andreas Vesalius published De humani corporis fabrica. Based on his own dissections, it corrected errors in Galen and established modern human anatomy.

events.title: 帕雷革新火器伤处理
events.title_en: Paré reforms the treatment of gunshot wounds
events.summary: 军医安布鲁瓦兹·帕雷弃用沸油处理枪伤，改用温和敷料与结扎止血，其外科著作影响全欧。
events.summary_en: The military surgeon Ambroise Paré abandoned boiling oil for gunshot wounds and turned to gentle dressings and ligature to stop bleeding. His surgical writings influenced all of Europe.

events.title: 弗拉卡斯托罗传染种子说
events.title_en: Fracastoro’s theory of seeds of contagion
events.summary: 吉罗拉莫·弗拉卡斯托罗1546年提出疫病由可传递的“种子”样实体引起，是近代传染理论的重要先声。
events.summary_en: In 1546 Girolamo Fracastoro proposed that epidemics are caused by transmissible seed-like entities. It was an important forerunner of modern contagion theory.

events.title: 塞尔维特描述肺循环
events.title_en: Servetus describes the pulmonary circulation
events.summary: 米格尔·塞尔维特1553年在神学著作中描述血液经肺循环，同年因异端罪名被处死，其生理见解影响有限但具历史意义。
events.summary_en: In 1553 Michael Servetus described the passage of blood through the lungs in a theological work. The same year he was executed for heresy. His physiological insight had limited influence, but it is historically significant.

events.title: 科伦布详述肺循环
events.title_en: Colombo describes the pulmonary circulation in more detail
events.summary: 雷阿尔多·科伦布1559年更详细描述肺循环，为哈维系统理论提供解剖学前提。
events.summary_en: In 1559 Realdo Colombo described the pulmonary circulation in greater detail, providing an anatomical premise for Harvey’s systematic theory.

events.title: 人痘接种术（明代）
events.title_en: Variolation in the Ming
events.summary: 明中后期中国出现人痘接种；有学者考证最早文献可至1522年，隆庆年间（1567–1572）记载较丰。后经阿拉伯、土耳其传入欧洲。
events.summary_en: In the middle and later Ming, variolation appeared in China. Some scholars trace the earliest text to 1522, while records are richer in the Longqing reign (1567–1572). The practice later reached Europe by way of the Arab world and Turkey.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine
Zheng Shanfu, study of the 1522 date

events.title: 奥尔塔《印度药物谈》
events.title_en: Garcia de Orta, Colloquies on the Simples and Drugs of India
events.summary: 加西亚·德·奥尔塔1563年在果阿出版印度药物与热带病论著，开创欧洲热带医学文献传统。
events.summary_en: In 1563 Garcia de Orta published in Goa a treatise on Indian drugs and tropical disease, opening a European literature of tropical medicine.

events.title: 李时珍《濒湖脉学》
events.title_en: Li Shizhen, Lakeside Pulse Studies
events.summary: 李时珍1564年著《濒湖脉学》，以歌赋总结27脉，成为脉学入门经典。
events.summary_en: In 1564 Li Shizhen wrote the Binhu Maixue. In verse it sums up 27 pulses and became a standard introduction to pulse study.

events.title: 一体堂宅仁医会
events.title_en: Yititang Zhairen Medical Society
events.summary: 1568年一体堂宅仁医会创办，是明代医师结社交流的早期例证。
events.summary_en: The Yititang Zhairen Medical Society was founded in 1568, an early example of Ming physicians organizing themselves for exchange.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 澳门出现西式医院
events.title_en: A Western-style hospital appears in Macao
events.summary: 1569年前后澳门出现西式医院，标志西医机构进入中国沿海，开启近代中西医相遇的空间。
events.summary_en: Around 1569 a Western-style hospital appeared in Macao. It marks the arrival of Western medical institutions on the Chinese coast and opens a space in which modern Chinese and Western medicine met.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 《奇经八脉考》
events.title_en: An Exposition on the Eight Extraordinary Vessels
events.summary: 李时珍1577年著《奇经八脉考》，系统考订奇经理论，与《濒湖脉学》同为脉系重要著作。
events.summary_en: In 1577 Li Shizhen wrote the Qijing Bamai Kao, a systematic study of the theory of the extraordinary vessels. With the Binhu Maixue it is an important work on the vessel system.
works_en: Qijing Bamai Kao (Exposition of the Eight Extraordinary Vessels)

events.title: 李时珍《本草纲目》刊行
events.title_en: Li Shizhen’s Compendium of Materia Medica is published
events.summary: 李时珍《本草纲目》1578年金陵版刊行，收药1892种，按纲目分类，是药物学与博物学巨著，后入选世界记忆名录。
events.summary_en: The Jinling edition of Li Shizhen’s Bencao Gangmu was published in 1578. It records 1,892 drugs, classified by headings and entries. It is a major work of pharmacy and natural history and was later inscribed on the Memory of the World Register.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 杨继洲《针灸大成》
events.title_en: Yang Jizhou, Great Compendium of Acupuncture and Moxibustion
events.summary: 杨继洲《针灸大成》约1601年刊行，集明以前针灸大成，影响后世针灸教学与临床。
events.summary_en: Yang Jizhou’s Zhenjiu Dacheng was published about 1601. It gathers the pre-Ming tradition of acupuncture and moxibustion and influenced later teaching and practice.
works_en: Zhenjiu Dacheng (Great Compendium of Acupuncture and Moxibustion)
sources_en: traditional literature on the history of acupuncture

events.title: 王肯堂《证治准绳》
events.title_en: Wang Kentang, Standards for Diagnosis and Treatment
events.summary: 王肯堂1602–1607年刊《证治准绳》，分科详尽，是明末重要临床全书。
events.summary_en: From 1602 to 1607 Wang Kentang published the Zhengzhi Zhunsheng. Divided in detail by specialty, it is an important late-Ming clinical compendium.
works_en: Zhengzhi Zhunsheng (Standards of Diagnosis and Treatment)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 法布里修斯发现静脉瓣
events.title_en: Fabricius discovers the venous valves
events.summary: 吉罗拉莫·法布里齐约1603年观察下肢静脉瓣，证明血液只能向心流动，直接启发哈维。
events.summary_en: In 1603 Hieronymus Fabricius observed the valves of the leg veins and showed that blood can flow only toward the heart, a direct inspiration for Harvey.

events.title: 桑托里奥计量生理学
events.title_en: Santorio and quantitative physiology
events.summary: 桑托里奥·桑托里奥以秤测“无形出汗”等，开创计量实验生理学先河。
events.summary_en: Santorio Santorio used a balance to measure “insensible perspiration” and other quantities, opening the way to quantitative experimental physiology.

events.title: 陈实功《外科正宗》
events.title_en: Chen Shigong, Orthodox Manual of External Medicine
events.summary: 陈实功1617年著《外科正宗》，对外科疮疡诊疗影响深远（常记为晚明刊行）。
events.summary_en: In 1617 Chen Shigong wrote the Waike Zhengzong. It had a lasting influence on the diagnosis and treatment of sores and ulcers in external medicine. It is usually dated to a late-Ming printing.
works_en: Waike Zhengzong (Orthodox Manual of External Medicine)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 张介宾《景岳全书》
events.title_en: Zhang Jiebin, Complete Works of Zhang Jingyue
events.summary: 张介宾1624年成《景岳全书》，倡阳非有余、温补理论，对明清临床影响巨大。
events.summary_en: In 1624 Zhang Jiebin completed the Jingyue Quanshu. He argued that yang is not in excess and developed warm-supplementation theory, with a large influence on Ming-Qing clinical practice.
works_en: Jingyue Quanshu (Complete Works of Zhang Jingyue)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 哈维《心血运动论》
events.title_en: Harvey, De Motu Cordis
events.summary: 威廉·哈维1628年出版《心血运动论》，以定量与实验论证血液循环，彻底改变生理学。
events.summary_en: In 1628 William Harvey published De Motu Cordis. With quantitative and experimental argument he demonstrated the circulation of the blood and thoroughly changed physiology.

events.title: 吴又可《温疫论》
events.title_en: Wu Youke, Treatise on Warm Epidemics
events.summary: 吴有性（又可）1642年著《温疫论》，提出“疠气”自口鼻而入，突破伤寒框架解释瘟疫，是温病学先声。
events.summary_en: In 1642 Wu Youxing (Youke) wrote the Wenyi Lun. He proposed that pestilential qi enters through the mouth and nose, breaking the cold-damage frame as an explanation of epidemics. It is a forerunner of warm-disease studies.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 马尔皮基发现毛细血管
events.title_en: Malpighi discovers the capillaries
events.summary: 马尔切洛·马尔皮基约1661年用显微镜观察毛细血管，填补哈维循环理论中动脉与静脉的连接环节。
events.summary_en: About 1661 Marcello Malpighi observed capillaries with a microscope, filling the missing link between arteries and veins in Harvey’s circulation.

events.title: 胡克命名“细胞”
events.title_en: Hooke names the “cell”
events.summary: 罗伯特·胡克1665年在显微镜下观察软木薄片并命名cells，虽未理解其生命意义，却开启显微形态学。
events.summary_en: In 1665 Robert Hooke observed thin slices of cork under a microscope and named cells. He did not yet understand their significance for life, but the observation opened microscopic morphology.

events.title: 同仁堂创建
events.title_en: Founding of Tongrentang
events.summary: 1669年同仁堂创立，成为著名中药老字号，象征清代成药商业与品质传统。
events.summary_en: Tongrentang was founded in 1669 and became a famous old firm of Chinese medicine, a symbol of Qing commercial prepared medicines and of a tradition of quality.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 列文虎克观察微生物
events.title_en: Leeuwenhoek observes microorganisms
events.summary: 安东尼·范·列文虎克1670年代用自制显微镜观察“微小动物”，为微生物学提供视觉证据。
events.summary_en: In the 1670s Antonie van Leeuwenhoek used microscopes he had made himself to observe “little animals,” providing visual evidence for microbiology.

events.title: 西德纳姆临床观察医学
events.title_en: Sydenham and clinical observation
events.summary: 托马斯·西德纳姆强调床边观察与疾病自然史，被誉为“英格兰希波克拉底”，影响经验临床医学。
events.summary_en: Thomas Sydenham emphasized bedside observation and the natural history of disease. He was called the “English Hippocrates” and influenced empirical clinical medicine.

events.title: 皮拉里尼在欧洲实施人痘接种
events.title_en: Pylarini performs variolation in Europe
events.summary: 1701年雅各莫·皮拉里尼在欧洲施行人痘接种；该术此前已在中国与奥斯曼等地流行，经蒙塔古夫人等传入英国。
events.summary_en: In 1701 Giacomo Pylarini performed variolation in Europe. The practice was already current in China and the Ottoman Empire and reached Britain through Lady Mary Wortley Montagu and others.

events.title: 布尔哈弗莱顿临床教学
events.title_en: Boerhaave’s clinical teaching at Leiden
events.summary: 赫尔曼·布尔哈弗在莱顿将床边教学与化学、解剖结合，培养全欧医师，代表18世纪初临床医学。
events.summary_en: Herman Boerhaave at Leiden joined bedside teaching to chemistry and anatomy and trained physicians from across Europe. He represents clinical medicine in the early 18th century.

events.title: 蒙塔古夫人引入人痘至英国
events.title_en: Lady Mary Wortley Montagu introduces variolation to Britain
events.summary: 玛丽·沃特利·蒙塔古夫人基于奥斯曼观察，约1721年推动人痘接种在英国贵族中试验推广。
events.summary_en: Drawing on Ottoman observation, Lady Mary Wortley Montagu about 1721 promoted trials of variolation among the British aristocracy.

events.title: 程国彭《医学心悟》
events.title_en: Cheng Guopeng, Awakening of the Mind in Medicine
events.summary: 程国彭1732年著《医学心悟》，以八纲与汗吐下和消清温补概括治法，影响临床教学。
events.summary_en: In 1732 Cheng Guopeng wrote the Yixue Xinwu. It sums up methods of treatment with the eight principles and with sweating, vomiting, purging, harmonizing, dispersing, clearing, warming, and supplementing, and it influenced clinical teaching.
works_en: Yixue Xinwu (Awakening of the Mind in Medicine)

events.title: 艾曼首例成功阑尾切除
events.title_en: Amyand’s early successful appendectomy
events.summary: 克劳迪乌斯·艾曼1736年完成文献记载较早的成功阑尾切除术。
events.summary_en: In 1736 Claudius Amyand completed a successful appendectomy that is among the earlier ones recorded in the literature.

events.title: 《医宗金鉴》刊印
events.title_en: The Golden Mirror of the Medical Tradition is printed
events.summary: 乾隆朝官修《医宗金鉴》1742年刊印，作为太医院教材，规范临床与考核。
events.summary_en: The official Yizong Jinjian of the Qianlong reign was printed in 1742. Used as a textbook of the Imperial Medical Academy, it standardized clinical practice and examinations.
works_en: Yizong Jinjian (Golden Mirror of the Medical Tradition)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 叶天士《温热论》
events.title_en: Ye Tianshi, Treatise on Warm-Heat Diseases
events.summary: 叶桂（天士）温热病经验约1746年整理为《温热论》，创立卫气营血辨证，标志温病学派成熟。
events.summary_en: Ye Gui’s (Tianshi) experience of warm-heat disease was arranged about 1746 as the Wenre Lun. It established four-level pattern differentiation—wei, qi, ying, and blood—and marks the maturity of the warm-disease school.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 林德柑橘防治坏血病试验
events.title_en: Lind’s trial of citrus against scurvy
events.summary: 詹姆斯·林德1747年在舰上进行对照试验，证明柑橘类可防治坏血病，是早期临床对照研究范例。
events.summary_en: In 1747 James Lind ran a controlled trial on a ship and showed that citrus could prevent and treat scurvy. It is an early example of a controlled clinical study.

events.title: 赵学敏《本草纲目拾遗》
events.title_en: Zhao Xuemin, Supplement to the Compendium of Materia Medica
events.summary: 赵学敏1765年著《本草纲目拾遗》，增补《纲目》未收药物与民间药，并有《串雅》记铃医经验。
events.summary_en: In 1765 Zhao Xuemin wrote the Bencao Gangmu Shiyi, adding drugs and folk medicines omitted from the Compendium. His Chuan Ya also records the experience of itinerant folk healers.
works_en: Bencao Gangmu Shiyi (Supplement to the Compendium of Materia Medica)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 约翰·亨特实验外科学
events.title_en: John Hunter and experimental surgery
events.summary: 约翰·亨特（1728–1793）以比较解剖与实验推动外科科学化，对动脉瘤等手术与病理学影响深远。
events.summary_en: John Hunter (1728–1793) used comparative anatomy and experiment to make surgery more scientific. His influence on operations such as those for aneurysm, and on pathology, was lasting.

events.title: 普里斯特利发现氧化亚氮
events.title_en: Priestley discovers nitrous oxide
events.summary: 约瑟夫·普里斯特利1774年发现氧化亚氮等气体；后被戴维注意其麻醉潜能。
events.summary_en: In 1774 Joseph Priestley discovered nitrous oxide and other gases. Davy later noticed its anesthetic potential.

events.title: 威瑟林洋地黄治疗水肿
events.title_en: Withering uses foxglove for dropsy
events.summary: 威廉·威瑟林1785年发表《关于洋地黄的记述》，系统描述洋地黄治疗水肿（心衰相关）的用法与毒性。
events.summary_en: In 1785 William Withering published An Account of the Foxglove, a systematic description of the use and toxicity of digitalis in dropsy related to heart failure.

events.title: 哈尼曼创立顺势疗法
events.title_en: Hahnemann founds homeopathy
events.summary: 塞缪尔·哈尼曼约1790年起反对放血等主流疗法并创立顺势疗法，成为近代另类医学重要流派（疗效争议大）。
events.summary_en: From about 1790 Samuel Hahnemann opposed mainstream treatments such as bloodletting and founded homeopathy. It became an important current of modern alternative medicine. Its efficacy is heavily disputed.

events.title: 詹纳牛痘接种
events.title_en: Jenner’s cowpox vaccination
events.summary: 爱德华·詹纳1796年用牛痘接种预防天花，开创安全疫苗接种，为后世消灭天花奠基。
events.summary_en: In 1796 Edward Jenner used cowpox inoculation to prevent smallpox, opening safer vaccination and laying a foundation for the later eradication of smallpox.

events.title: 拉雷飞骑救护与战伤外科
events.title_en: Larrey’s flying ambulance and war surgery
events.summary: 拿破仑军医多米尼克·拉雷改进战地救护（飞骑救护车）与截肢时机，推动军事外科学。
events.summary_en: Napoleon’s surgeon Dominique Jean Larrey improved battlefield evacuation with the flying ambulance and the timing of amputation, and he advanced military surgery.

events.title: 吴鞠通《温病条辨》
events.title_en: Wu Jutong, Systematic Differentiation of Warm Diseases
events.summary: 吴瑭（鞠通）1798年著《温病条辨》，创立三焦辨证，与叶天士并称温病学高峰。
events.summary_en: In 1798 Wu Tang (Jutong) wrote the Wenbing Tiaobian. He established triple-burner pattern differentiation and, with Ye Tianshi, marks a high point of warm-disease studies.
works_en: Wenbing Tiaobian (Systematic Differentiation of Warm Diseases)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 俞根初《通俗伤寒论》
events.title_en: Yu Genchu, Popular Treatise on Cold Damage
events.summary: 俞根初约1799年《通俗伤寒论》倡导寒温融合，反映明清伤寒与温病对话。
events.summary_en: About 1799 Yu Genchu’s Tongsu Shanghan Lun advocated joining cold-damage and warm-disease approaches, reflecting the Ming-Qing conversation between the two.
works_en: Tongsu Shanghan Lun (Popular Treatise on Cold Damage)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 戴维指出氧化亚氮麻醉性
events.title_en: Davy notes that nitrous oxide is anesthetic
events.summary: 汉弗莱·戴维1799–1800年记述氧化亚氮可缓解疼痛，为吸入麻醉史提供早期线索。
events.summary_en: In 1799–1800 Humphry Davy recorded that nitrous oxide can relieve pain, an early clue in the history of inhalation anesthesia.

events.title: 塞尔蒂纳纳分离吗啡
events.title_en: Sertürner isolates morphine
events.summary: 弗里德里希·塞尔蒂纳纳约1804年自鸦片分离吗啡，是植物活性成分分离的里程碑，开启生物碱化学。
events.summary_en: About 1804 Friedrich Sertürner isolated morphine from opium. It was a milestone in separating active plant constituents and opened alkaloid chemistry.

events.title: 牛痘法传入广州
events.title_en: Cowpox vaccination reaches Guangzhou
events.summary: 1805年牛痘接种经澳门/广州传入中国，逐渐替代人痘，是免疫史与中西医交流的重要节点。
events.summary_en: In 1805 cowpox vaccination reached China through Macao and Guangzhou and gradually replaced variolation. It is an important point in the history of immunity and of exchange between Chinese and Western medicine.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 雷奈克发明听诊器
events.title_en: Laennec invents the stethoscope
events.summary: 勒内·雷奈克1816年发明听诊器，使心肺体征可客观听诊，革新诊断学。
events.summary_en: In 1816 René Laennec invented the stethoscope, making heart and lung signs objectively audible and transforming diagnosis.

events.title: 布兰德尔成功人体输血
events.title_en: Blundell’s successful human transfusion
events.summary: 詹姆斯·布兰德尔1818年完成早期成功的人体输血尝试，为输血医学开辟道路（血型发现前风险极高）。
events.summary_en: In 1818 James Blundell completed an early successful attempt at human transfusion, opening a path for transfusion medicine. Before blood groups were known, the risk was extremely high.

events.title: 傅青主妇科传本
events.title_en: The transmitted text of Fu Qingzhu’s gynecology
events.summary: 托名或传自傅山的《傅青主女科》清中后期广泛刊行，对妇科辨证处方影响极大。
events.summary_en: Fu Qingzhu’s Gynecology, attributed to or transmitted from Fu Shan, circulated widely in the middle and later Qing and strongly influenced gynecological pattern differentiation and prescribing.

events.title: 王清任《医林改错》
events.title_en: Wang Qingren, Correction of Errors in Medical Works
events.summary: 王清任1830年刊《医林改错》，强调尸体脏器观察并创活血化瘀诸方，对血瘀证研究影响深远。
events.summary_en: In 1830 Wang Qingren published the Yilin Gaicuo. He emphasized observation of organs in corpses and created formulas for invigorating blood and transforming stasis. His influence on the study of blood-stasis patterns was lasting.
works_en: Yilin Gaicuo (Correction of Errors in Medical Works)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 伯驾广州眼科医局（博济前身）
events.title_en: Peter Parker’s Ophthalmic Hospital in Guangzhou (forerunner of Boji Hospital)
events.summary: 美国传教士医生伯驾1835年在广州开设眼科医局，后发展为博济医院，是中国近代西医院先驱。
events.summary_en: In 1835 the American missionary physician Peter Parker opened an ophthalmic hospital in Guangzhou. It later developed into Boji Hospital and was a pioneer of modern Western hospitals in China.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 查德威克《卫生状况报告》
events.title_en: Chadwick’s report on sanitary conditions
events.summary: 埃德温·查德威克1842年报告推动英国卫生改革立法，将清洁供水与排污纳入国家责任。
events.summary_en: Edwin Chadwick’s 1842 report pushed sanitary-reform legislation in Britain and brought clean water and sewage into the responsibilities of the state.

events.title: 克劳福德·朗乙醚麻醉手术
events.title_en: Crawford Long operates under ether
events.summary: 克劳福德·朗1842年用乙醚施行无痛手术，但未及时发表；乙醚麻醉的公开示范稍后由莫顿完成。
events.summary_en: In 1842 Crawford Long used ether for painless surgery, but he did not publish in time. The public demonstration of ether anesthesia was given a little later by Morton.

events.title: 莫顿公开乙醚麻醉示范
events.title_en: Morton’s public demonstration of ether anesthesia
events.summary: 1846年10月威廉·莫顿在麻省总医院公开乙醚麻醉手术，全麻迅速传播，外科进入无痛时代。
events.summary_en: In October 1846 William Morton publicly demonstrated surgery under ether at Massachusetts General Hospital. General anesthesia spread quickly, and surgery entered an era without operative pain.

events.title: 塞麦尔维斯洗手防产褥热
events.title_en: Semmelweis and handwashing against puerperal fever
events.summary: 伊格纳茨·塞麦尔维斯1847年发现医师洗手可大幅降低产褥热死亡率，却遭同行抵制，是感染控制先驱。
events.summary_en: In 1847 Ignaz Semmelweis found that physicians’ handwashing could sharply reduce deaths from puerperal fever. Colleagues resisted him. He was a pioneer of infection control.

events.title: 伊丽莎白·布莱克韦尔获医学学位
events.title_en: Elizabeth Blackwell receives a medical degree
events.summary: 1849年伊丽莎白·布莱克韦尔成为美国首位获医学学位的女性，推动女性进入医学职业。
events.summary_en: In 1849 Elizabeth Blackwell became the first woman to receive a medical degree in the United States, helping to open the medical profession to women.

events.title: 王孟英《温热经纬》
events.title_en: Wang Mengying, Warp and Weft of Warm-Heat Diseases
events.summary: 王士雄（孟英）1852年辑《温热经纬》，整理叶薛吴等温病学说，是晚清温病学重要选本。
events.summary_en: In 1852 Wang Shixiong (Mengying) compiled the Wenre Jingwei, arranging the warm-disease doctrines of Ye, Xue, Wu, and others. It is an important late-Qing anthology of warm-disease studies.
works_en: Wenre Jingwei (Warp and Weft of Warm-Heat Diseases)

events.title: 斯诺霍乱地图与水泵
events.title_en: Snow’s cholera map and the Broad Street pump
events.summary: 约翰·斯诺1854年通过伦敦宽街霍乱地图论证水源传播，成为流行病学经典案例。
events.summary_en: In 1854 John Snow used a map of cholera on Broad Street in London to argue for transmission by water. The case became a classic of epidemiology.

events.title: 魏尔啸细胞病理学
events.title_en: Virchow’s cellular pathology
events.summary: 鲁道夫·魏尔啸1858年前后确立细胞病理学，以细胞病变解释疾病，标志体液论的终结。
events.summary_en: Around 1858 Rudolf Virchow established cellular pathology, explaining disease by changes in cells and marking the end of humoral theory.

events.title: 南丁格尔护理学校
events.title_en: The Nightingale nursing school
events.summary: 弗洛伦斯·南丁格尔克里米亚战争后推动医院卫生改革，1860年在圣托马斯医院创办护理学校，奠基现代护理。
events.summary_en: After the Crimean War, Florence Nightingale pushed hospital sanitary reform. In 1860 she founded a nursing school at St Thomas’ Hospital and laid the foundation of modern nursing.

events.title: 巴斯德微生物致病研究
events.title_en: Pasteur’s research on microbial causes of disease
events.summary: 路易·巴斯德1860年代以发酵与灭菌实验支持微生物致病，否定自然发生说，奠定微生物学与灭菌术基础。
events.summary_en: In the 1860s Louis Pasteur’s experiments on fermentation and sterilization supported the idea that microorganisms cause disease, rejected spontaneous generation, and laid the foundation of microbiology and sterilization.

events.title: 吴师机《理瀹骈文》
events.title_en: Wu Shiji's Liyue pianwen
events.summary: 清代吴师机以骈文写成外治专书，系统论述膏药、敷贴、熏洗等外治法，提出“外治之理即内治之理”。
events.summary_en: Wu Shiji of the Qing dynasty wrote a book on external treatment in parallel prose. It sets out plasters, poultices, fumigation and washes, holding that external and internal treatment follow the same principles.

events.title: 贝尔纳实验生理学与内环境
events.title_en: Bernard’s experimental physiology and the internal environment
events.summary: 克洛德·贝尔纳提出内环境稳定等概念，确立现代实验生理学方法。
events.summary_en: Claude Bernard proposed concepts such as the stability of the internal environment and established the methods of modern experimental physiology.
works: Introduction to the Study of Experimental Medicine
works_en: Introduction to the Study of Experimental Medicine

events.title: 李斯特抗菌外科原则
events.title_en: Lister’s antiseptic principle of surgery
events.summary: 约瑟夫·李斯特1867年发表抗菌外科原则，用石炭酸消毒，显著降低术后感染，开创无菌外科时代。
events.summary_en: In 1867 Joseph Lister published the antiseptic principle of surgery, using carbolic acid for disinfection. Postoperative infection fell sharply, and the era of antiseptic surgery began.
works: Antiseptic Principle of the Practice of Surgery
works_en: Antiseptic Principle of the Practice of Surgery

events.title: 科赫与巴斯德确立细菌学说
events.title_en: Koch and Pasteur establish the germ theory
events.summary: 约1870年代罗伯特·科赫与巴斯德共同确立细菌致病学说；科赫后来提出科赫法则并发现结核杆菌等。
events.summary_en: In the 1870s Robert Koch and Pasteur together established the doctrine that bacteria cause disease. Koch later stated Koch’s postulates and discovered the tubercle bacillus, among other organisms.

events.title: 早期霍乱疫苗
events.title_en: Early cholera vaccines
events.summary: 约1879年出现早期霍乱疫苗尝试，反映细菌学时代疫苗研发的迅速扩展（后续剂型不断改进）。
events.summary_en: About 1879 early attempts at a cholera vaccine appeared, reflecting the rapid spread of vaccine development in the bacteriological era. Later preparations continued to be improved.

events.title: 巴斯德炭疽减毒疫苗
events.title_en: Pasteur’s attenuated anthrax vaccine
events.summary: 1881年巴斯德公开演示炭疽减毒疫苗，证明可用减弱病原诱导免疫，推动疫苗学。
events.summary_en: In 1881 Pasteur publicly demonstrated an attenuated anthrax vaccine, showing that a weakened pathogen could induce immunity and advancing vaccinology.

events.title: 科赫发现结核杆菌
events.title_en: Koch discovers the tubercle bacillus
