events.summary: 罗伯特·科赫1882年分离结核分枝杆菌，并用严格实验证明其致病性，1905年获诺贝尔奖。
events.summary_en: In 1882 Robert Koch isolated Mycobacterium tuberculosis and proved its pathogenicity with strict experiments. He received the Nobel Prize in 1905.

events.title: 唐容川中西汇通
events.title_en: Tang Rongchuan and the convergence of Chinese and Western medicine
events.summary: 唐宗海（容川）1884年著《中西汇通医书五种》，尝试会通中西医学，开启近代中西医汇通思潮。
events.summary_en: In 1884 Tang Zonghai (Rongchuan) wrote Five Books on the Convergence of Chinese and Western Medicine. He tried to bring the two medicines into communication and opened the modern current of Chinese-Western convergence.
works_en: Five Books on the Convergence of Chinese and Western Medicine
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 科赫法则系统表述
events.title_en: Koch’s postulates are stated systematically
events.summary: 罗伯特·科赫在研究病原菌过程中形成后称“科赫法则”的验证步骤，成为传染病病因学标准。
events.summary_en: In the course of studying pathogenic bacteria, Robert Koch formed the verification steps later called Koch’s postulates. They became a standard of infectious-disease etiology.

events.title: 巴斯德狂犬病疫苗用于人体
events.title_en: Pasteur’s rabies vaccine is used in humans
events.summary: 1885年巴斯德团队将狂犬病疫苗用于人体，是詹纳之后重大的人类疫苗突破；1888年巴斯德研究所成立。
events.summary_en: In 1885 Pasteur’s team used a rabies vaccine in humans, a major human-vaccine advance after Jenner. The Pasteur Institute was founded in 1888.

events.title: 巴斯德研究所成立
events.title_en: Founding of the Pasteur Institute
events.summary: 1888年巴黎巴斯德研究所开幕，成为全球生物医学研究机构的早期典范。
events.summary_en: The Pasteur Institute in Paris opened in 1888 and became an early model of a biomedical research institution.

events.title: 贝林抗毒素与白喉破伤风血清
events.title_en: Behring’s antitoxin and diphtheria and tetanus serum
events.summary: 埃米尔·冯·贝林1890年发现抗毒素并用于白喉与破伤风，开创血清疗法，1901年获首届诺贝尔生理学或医学奖。
events.summary_en: In 1890 Emil von Behring discovered antitoxin and used it for diphtheria and tetanus, opening serum therapy. In 1901 he received the first Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine.

events.title: 霍尔斯特德外科原则
events.title_en: Halsted’s surgical principles
events.summary: 威廉·霍尔斯特德在约翰斯·霍普金斯推行严格消毒、轻柔操作与住院医师制度，塑造现代外科训练。
events.summary_en: William Halsted at Johns Hopkins promoted strict asepsis, gentle technique, and the residency system, shaping modern surgical training.

events.title: 伦琴发现X射线
events.title_en: Röntgen discovers X-rays
events.summary: 威廉·伦琴1895年发现X射线并迅速用于医学成像，开创放射诊断学。
events.summary_en: In 1895 Wilhelm Röntgen discovered X-rays, which were quickly used for medical imaging and opened diagnostic radiology.

events.title: 里瓦-罗奇血压计
events.title_en: The Riva-Rocci sphygmomanometer
events.summary: 希皮奥内·里瓦-罗奇1896年发明袖带血压计，使无创血压测量进入临床常规。
events.summary_en: In 1896 Scipione Riva-Rocci invented the cuff sphygmomanometer, bringing noninvasive blood-pressure measurement into routine clinical use.

events.title: 拜耳推出阿司匹林
events.title_en: Bayer introduces aspirin
events.summary: 1899年拜耳公司推出阿司匹林（乙酰水杨酸）；水杨酸类镇痛解热传统可追溯至希波克拉底时代的柳树应用。
events.summary_en: In 1899 Bayer introduced aspirin (acetylsalicylic acid). The analgesic and antipyretic tradition of salicylates can be traced to the Hippocratic use of willow.

events.title: 阿尔茨海默描述病例
events.title_en: Alzheimer describes a case
events.summary: 阿洛伊斯·阿尔茨海默1901年识别后来称为阿尔茨海默病的病例，开创神经退行性疾病临床病理研究。
events.summary_en: In 1901 Alois Alzheimer identified the case later called Alzheimer’s disease, opening clinical and pathological study of neurodegenerative disease.

events.title: 兰德施泰纳发现血型
events.title_en: Landsteiner discovers blood groups
events.summary: 卡尔·兰德施泰纳1901年发现ABO血型，使安全输血成为可能，1930年获诺贝尔奖。
events.summary_en: In 1901 Karl Landsteiner discovered the ABO blood groups, making safer transfusion possible. He received the Nobel Prize in 1930.

events.title: 卡雷尔血管缝合术
events.title_en: Carrel’s vascular suture
events.summary: 亚历克西斯·卡雷尔发展血管吻合技术，为器官移植与血管外科奠基，1912年获诺贝尔奖。
events.summary_en: Alexis Carrel developed techniques of vascular anastomosis, a foundation of organ transplantation and vascular surgery. He received the Nobel Prize in 1912.

events.title: 艾因托芬心电图
events.title_en: Einthoven’s electrocardiogram
events.summary: 威廉·艾因托芬约1903年完善弦线电流计心电图，使心脏电活动可记录，奠定临床心电学（常记为1903年实用化）。
events.summary_en: About 1903 Willem Einthoven refined the string-galvanometer electrocardiogram so that the heart’s electrical activity could be recorded, establishing clinical electrocardiography. The practical form is often dated to 1903.

events.title: 霍普金斯提出维生素概念
events.title_en: Frederick Hopkins proposes the vitamin concept
events.summary: 弗雷德里克·霍普金斯1906年提出食物中存在必需微量因子（维生素），解释坏血病、佝偻病等缺乏病。
events.summary_en: In 1906 Frederick Hopkins proposed that foods contain essential trace factors (vitamins), explaining deficiency diseases such as scurvy and rickets.

events.title: 张锡纯《医学衷中参西录》
events.title_en: Zhang Xichun, Records of Chinese Medicine with Reference to Western Medicine
events.summary: 张锡纯1909年起刊《医学衷中参西录》，以中医为本参用西药西理，是近代中西汇通代表作。
events.summary_en: From 1909 Zhang Xichun published the Yixue Zhongzhong Canxi Lu. Taking Chinese medicine as the basis and drawing on Western drugs and reasoning, it is a representative modern work of Chinese-Western convergence.
works_en: Yixue Zhongzhong Canxi Lu (Records of Chinese Medicine with Reference to Western Medicine)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 埃利希化学疗法（洒尔佛散）
events.title_en: Ehrlich’s chemotherapy (Salvarsan)
events.summary: 保罗·埃利希约1909年研制砷化合物洒尔佛散治疗梅毒，提出“魔弹”概念，开创抗微生物化疗。
events.summary_en: About 1909 Paul Ehrlich developed the arsenic compound Salvarsan for syphilis and proposed the “magic bullet,” opening antimicrobial chemotherapy.

events.title: 洒尔佛散治疗梅毒上市
events.title_en: Salvarsan for syphilis comes into use
events.summary: 埃利希与秦佐八郎研制的砷剂洒尔佛散（606）约1910年用于梅毒，标志化疗药物时代。
events.summary_en: The arsenic preparation Salvarsan (606), developed by Ehrlich and Sahachiro Hata, was used for syphilis about 1910 and marks the era of chemotherapeutic drugs.

events.title: 弗莱克斯纳报告改革北美医学教育
events.title_en: The Flexner Report reforms North American medical education
events.summary: 亚伯拉罕·弗莱克斯纳1910年报告促使北美关闭不合格医校，确立大学—实验室—医院三位一体的现代医学教育模式。
events.summary_en: Abraham Flexner’s 1910 report led to the closure of substandard medical schools in North America and established the modern model of medical education joining university, laboratory, and hospital.

events.title: 伍连德主持东北肺鼠疫防控
events.title_en: Wu Lien-teh leads the Manchurian pneumonic plague response
events.summary: 1910—1911年东北肺鼠疫流行，伍连德通过尸体解剖确认飞沫传播，推行隔离、口罩和遗体火化，1911年在奉天主持万国鼠疫研究会。
events.summary_en: During the 1910–1911 pneumonic plague in Manchuria, Wu Lien-teh confirmed airborne spread by autopsy and introduced isolation, masks and cremation. In 1911 he chaired the International Plague Conference in Mukden.

events.title: 中华医学会成立
events.title_en: Founding of the Chinese Medical Association
events.summary: 1915年中华医学会成立并创刊《中华医学杂志》，主要推动现代西医学在中国的职业化（与中医界并行）。
events.summary_en: In 1915 the Chinese Medical Association was founded and launched the National Medical Journal of China. It mainly advanced the professionalization of modern Western medicine in China, alongside the Chinese-medicine community.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 上海中医专门学校开学
events.title_en: The Shanghai Specialized School of Chinese Medicine opens
events.summary: 1917年上海中医专门学校开学，代表近代中医学校教育对传统师承的补充。
events.summary_en: In 1917 the Shanghai Specialized School of Chinese Medicine opened, representing a modern school education in Chinese medicine that supplemented traditional apprenticeship.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 噬菌体发现
events.title_en: Discovery of bacteriophage
events.summary: 约1915–1917年特沃特与德埃雷尔发现噬菌体，后成为分子遗传与替代抗菌研究的重要对象。
events.summary_en: About 1915–1917 Frederick Twort and Félix d’Hérelle discovered bacteriophage, which later became an important object of molecular genetics and of research on alternatives to antibacterials.

events.title: 班廷与贝斯特发现胰岛素
events.title_en: Banting and Best discover insulin
events.summary: 弗雷德里克·班廷与查尔斯·贝斯特1921年分离胰岛素，使1型糖尿病从绝症变为可治，1923年班廷获诺贝尔奖。
events.summary_en: In 1921 Frederick Banting and Charles Best isolated insulin, turning type 1 diabetes from a fatal disease into a treatable one. Banting received the Nobel Prize in 1923.

events.title: 卡介苗（BCG）
events.title_en: BCG vaccine
events.summary: 卡尔梅特与介林研制的卡介苗1920年代开始用于结核预防，成为全球使用最广的疫苗之一。
events.summary_en: The BCG vaccine developed by Albert Calmette and Camille Guérin began to be used to prevent tuberculosis in the 1920s and became one of the most widely used vaccines in the world.

events.title: 恽铁樵《群经见智录》
events.title_en: Yun Tieqiao, Insights from the Medical Classics
events.summary: 恽铁樵1922年著《群经见智录》批驳余云岫《灵素商兑》，是近代中医理论自卫的重要文献。
events.summary_en: In 1922 Yun Tieqiao wrote the Qunjing Jianzhi Lu, rebutting Yu Yunxiu’s Ling Su Shangdui (a critique of the Lingshu and Suwen). It is an important modern defense of Chinese medical theory.
works_en: Qunjing Jianzhi Lu (Insights Gained from the Classics)
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 米诺特肝食疗法治疗恶性贫血
events.title_en: Minot and Murphy’s liver diet for pernicious anemia
events.summary: 乔治·米诺特与威廉·墨菲1926年用肝食疗法治疗恶性贫血，导向维生素B12发现，1923年后获诺贝尔奖。
events.summary_en: In 1926 George Minot and William Murphy treated pernicious anemia with a liver diet, pointing toward the discovery of vitamin B12, and received the Nobel Prize after 1923.

events.title: 弗莱明发现青霉素
events.title_en: Fleming discovers penicillin
events.summary: 亚历山大·弗莱明1928年发现青霉素抑菌现象；后经弗洛里、钱恩等 stat 量产，开启抗生素时代。
events.summary_en: In 1928 Alexander Fleming observed the antibacterial effect of penicillin. Florey, Chain, and others later produced it at scale, opening the antibiotic era.

events.title: “废止旧医案”与中医请愿
events.title_en: The proposal to abolish traditional medicine, and the Chinese-medicine petition
events.summary: 1929年余云岫等提出废止中医案，全国中医药界赴南京请愿反对，成为近代中医存废斗争的标志事件。
events.summary_en: In 1929 Yu Yunxiu and others proposed abolishing Chinese medicine. Chinese-medicine communities from across the country petitioned in Nanjing against it. The episode became the emblematic modern struggle over whether Chinese medicine should survive.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 福斯曼自体心导管术
events.title_en: Forssmann's self-catheterisation of the heart
events.summary: 德国医生福斯曼把导管经自己的肘静脉送入右心并拍片证实，开启心导管技术，1956年获诺贝尔生理学或医学奖。
events.summary_en: The German physician Werner Forssmann passed a catheter through a vein in his own arm into his right heart and confirmed it on X-ray. This began cardiac catheterisation; he shared the 1956 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine.

events.title: 中央国医馆成立
events.title_en: Founding of the Central Institute of National Medicine
events.summary: 1931年中央国医馆成立，推动中医“科学化”整理与教育制度建设。
events.summary_en: The Central Institute of National Medicine was founded in 1931. It promoted a “scientific” reorganization of Chinese medicine and the building of an education system.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 多马克磺胺化疗
events.title_en: Domagk and sulfonamide chemotherapy
events.summary: 格哈德·多马克1932年发现磺胺类药物抗链球菌作用，是抗生素普及前重要的化学治疗突破。
events.summary_en: In 1932 Gerhard Domagk discovered the antistreptococcal action of sulfonamides, an important chemotherapeutic advance before antibiotics were widespread.

events.title: 王吉民、伍连德《中国医史》
events.title_en: Wong and Wu publish History of Chinese Medicine
events.summary: 王吉民与伍连德用英文写成《中国医史》，系统介绍中国传统医学和西医在华传播的历史，是较早面向国际读者的中国医学通史。
events.summary_en: K. Chimin Wong and Wu Lien-teh wrote History of Chinese Medicine in English, covering both traditional Chinese medicine and the spread of Western medicine in China. It was an early general history of Chinese medicine for international readers.

events.title: 《中医条例》颁布
events.title_en: Promulgation of the Regulations on Chinese Medicine
events.summary: 1936年南京国民政府颁布《中医条例》，在法律上承认中医执业地位（实施仍曲折）。
events.summary_en: In 1936 the Nationalist government in Nanjing promulgated the Regulations on Chinese Medicine, legally recognizing the right to practice Chinese medicine. Implementation remained uneven.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 黄热病疫苗
events.title_en: Yellow-fever vaccine
events.summary: 马克斯·泰勒等1930年代研制黄热病减毒疫苗（17D株约1937），显著降低热带地区黄热病负担。
events.summary_en: In the 1930s Max Theiler and others developed an attenuated yellow-fever vaccine (the 17D strain, about 1937), sharply reducing the burden of yellow fever in the tropics.

events.title: 弗洛里与钱恩推动青霉素量产
events.title_en: Florey and Chain push penicillin into mass production
events.summary: 约1938–1940年代霍华德·弗洛里与恩斯特·钱恩提纯并试用青霉素，二战期间实现量产，拯救无数伤员。
events.summary_en: About 1938–1940 Howard Florey and Ernst Chain purified penicillin and tried it clinically. During the Second World War it was produced at scale and saved countless wounded.

events.title: 科尔夫人工肾透析机
events.title_en: Kolff’s artificial-kidney dialysis machine
events.summary: 威廉·科尔夫1943年制成首台实用透析机，开创肾功能替代治疗。
events.summary_en: In 1943 Willem Kolff built the first practical dialysis machine, opening renal replacement therapy.

events.title: 瓦克斯曼链霉素
events.title_en: Waksman’s streptomycin
events.summary: 塞尔曼·瓦克斯曼实验室1943年发现链霉素，是首个有效抗结核抗生素，1952年瓦克斯曼获诺贝尔奖。
events.summary_en: In 1943 Selman Waksman’s laboratory discovered streptomycin, the first effective antibiotic against tuberculosis. Waksman received the Nobel Prize in 1952.

events.title: 世界卫生组织成立
events.title_en: Founding of the World Health Organization
events.summary: 1948年联合国专门机构世界卫生组织（WHO）成立，推动全球公共卫生、传染病控制与卫生标准。
events.summary_en: In 1948 the World Health Organization, a specialized agency of the United Nations, was founded. It advanced global public health, the control of infectious disease, and health standards.

events.title: 可的松用于类风湿关节炎
events.title_en: Cortisone used for rheumatoid arthritis
events.summary: 菲利普·亨奇等1940年代末将可的松用于类风湿关节炎，开启糖皮质激素治疗时代。
events.summary_en: In the late 1940s Philip Hench and others used cortisone for rheumatoid arthritis, opening the era of glucocorticoid treatment.

events.title: 第一届全国卫生会议“团结中西医”
events.title_en: The First National Health Conference: “unite Chinese and Western medicine”
events.summary: 1950年第一届全国卫生会议提出“面向工农兵、预防为主、团结中西医”，奠定新中国卫生与中医政策基调。
events.summary_en: In 1950 the First National Health Conference proposed “serve workers, peasants, and soldiers; put prevention first; unite Chinese and Western medicine,” setting the tone of health policy and Chinese-medicine policy in the new China.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 阿普加新生儿评分
events.title_en: The Apgar score for newborns
events.summary: 麻醉医师阿普加提出用心率、呼吸、肌张力、反射和肤色五项快速评估新生儿状况，1953年发表后成为产房通用方法。
events.summary_en: The anaesthesiologist Virginia Apgar proposed rating newborns quickly on heart rate, breathing, muscle tone, reflexes and colour. Published in 1953, it became standard practice in delivery rooms.

events.title: 《中华人民共和国药典》首版
events.title_en: First edition of the Pharmacopoeia of the People’s Republic of China
events.summary: 1953年《中国药典》第一版问世，后续版本逐步系统收载中药材与中成药标准。
events.summary_en: The first edition of the Chinese Pharmacopoeia appeared in 1953. Later editions gradually and systematically included standards for Chinese medicinal materials and prepared Chinese medicines.
works_en: Pharmacopoeia of the People's Republic of China
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 吉本心肺机体外循环
events.title_en: Gibbon’s heart-lung machine and extracorporeal circulation
events.summary: 约翰·吉本1953年用心肺机完成体外循环心内直视手术，使心内外科成为可能。
events.summary_en: In 1953 John Gibbon used a heart-lung machine to complete open-heart surgery under extracorporeal circulation, making intracardiac surgery possible.

events.title: 医学超声心动图萌芽
events.title_en: The beginnings of medical echocardiography
events.summary: 英格·埃德勒等1950年代发展超声心动图，医学超声随后扩展至产科与腹部成像。
events.summary_en: In the 1950s Inge Edler and others developed echocardiography. Medical ultrasound later extended to obstetrics and abdominal imaging.

events.title: 沃森与克里克DNA双螺旋
events.title_en: Watson and Crick’s DNA double helix
events.summary: 詹姆斯·沃森与弗朗西斯·克里克1953年提出DNA双螺旋结构（依托富兰克林等数据），开启分子生物学医学时代。
events.summary_en: In 1953 James Watson and Francis Crick proposed the double-helix structure of DNA, relying on data from Rosalind Franklin and others. It opened the era of molecular-biology medicine.

events.title: 卫生部中医司成立
events.title_en: A Department of Traditional Chinese Medicine is established in the Ministry of Health
events.summary: 1954年卫生部成立中医司，中央批转改进中医工作报告，中医行政管理强化。
events.summary_en: In 1954 the Ministry of Health established a Department of Traditional Chinese Medicine. The center circulated a report on improving work in Chinese medicine, and administrative management of Chinese medicine was strengthened.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 索尔克疫苗大规模现场试验
events.title_en: The large field trial of the Salk vaccine
events.summary: 1954年美国开展史上最大规模之一的脊灰疫苗现场试验，次年批准使用。
events.summary_en: In 1954 the United States ran one of the largest field trials in history, of a polio vaccine. Use was approved the following year.

events.title: 默里同卵双生子肾移植
events.title_en: Murray’s kidney transplant between identical twins
events.summary: 约瑟夫·默里1954年在同卵双生子间完成首例成功人体肾移植，开创器官移植临床时代。
events.summary_en: In 1954 Joseph Murray completed the first successful human kidney transplant, between identical twins, opening the clinical era of organ transplantation.

events.title: 中医研究院成立
events.title_en: Founding of the Academy of Traditional Chinese Medicine
events.summary: 1955年卫生部中医研究院（后中国中医科学院）成立，并开办西医学习中医班，标志国家级中医研究机构起步。
events.summary_en: In 1955 the Academy of Traditional Chinese Medicine of the Ministry of Health (later the China Academy of Chinese Medical Sciences) was founded, and classes were opened for Western-trained physicians to study Chinese medicine. It marks the start of a national research institution for Chinese medicine.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 索尔克脊髓灰质炎疫苗
events.title_en: Salk’s poliomyelitis vaccine
events.summary: 乔纳斯·索尔克研制的灭活脊灰疫苗1955年投入使用，大幅降低脊灰发病率；萨宾口服活疫苗随后推广。
events.summary_en: Jonas Salk’s inactivated polio vaccine came into use in 1955 and sharply reduced the incidence of polio. Sabin’s live oral vaccine was promoted afterward.

events.title: 北京等中医学院成立
events.title_en: Colleges of Chinese medicine are founded in Beijing and elsewhere
events.summary: 1956年北京、上海、广州、成都中医学院成立，开创现代高等中医教育体系。
events.summary_en: In 1956 colleges of Chinese medicine were founded in Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, and Chengdu, opening the modern system of higher education in Chinese medicine.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: “中国医药学是一个伟大的宝库”批示
events.title_en: The instruction that “Chinese medicine and pharmacology are a great treasure-house”
events.summary: 1958年毛泽东批示强调发掘提高中医药，深刻影响此后中医政策与西学中运动。
events.summary_en: In 1958 Mao Zedong wrote an instruction stressing that Chinese medicine and pharmacology should be excavated and raised to a higher level. It deeply influenced later Chinese-medicine policy and the movement of Western-trained physicians studying Chinese medicine.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 植入式心脏起搏器
events.title_en: The implantable cardiac pacemaker
events.summary: 约1958年埃尔姆奎斯特与森宁等实现植入式起搏器，开启心脏电生理器械治疗。
events.summary_en: About 1958 Rune Elmqvist, Åke Senning, and others achieved an implantable pacemaker, opening device therapy in cardiac electrophysiology.

events.title: 中医学院试用教材出版
events.title_en: Trial textbooks for colleges of Chinese medicine are published
events.summary: 1960年左右17种中医学院试用教材出版，统一高等中医教学内容与术语。
events.summary_en: Around 1960, 17 trial textbooks for colleges of Chinese medicine were published, unifying the content and terminology of higher Chinese-medicine education.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 口服避孕药获批
events.title_en: The oral contraceptive is approved
events.summary: 1960年复方口服避孕药在美国获批，深刻改变生殖健康、女性医疗与社会史。
events.summary_en: In 1960 a combined oral contraceptive was approved in the United States. It deeply changed reproductive health, women’s medical care, and social history.

events.title: 萨宾口服脊灰疫苗
events.title_en: Sabin’s oral polio vaccine
events.summary: 阿尔伯特·萨宾口服减毒脊灰疫苗1960年代初推广，便于群体免疫，推动全球消灭脊灰行动。
events.summary_en: Albert Sabin’s oral attenuated polio vaccine was promoted in the early 1960s. It was convenient for herd immunity and advanced the global effort to eradicate polio.

events.title: 麻疹疫苗
events.title_en: Measles vaccine
events.summary: 1963年麻疹疫苗上市，后纳入MMR，显著降低儿童麻疹死亡率。
events.summary_en: A measles vaccine came on the market in 1963 and was later included in MMR, sharply reducing deaths from measles in children.

events.title: 针刺麻醉用于手术
events.title_en: Acupuncture anesthesia used in surgery
events.summary: 1960年代针刺麻醉用于外科手术并引起国际关注，推动针灸机理与麻醉学研究（适应证与评价后来更审慎）。
events.summary_en: In the 1960s acupuncture anesthesia was used in surgery and drew international attention, pushing research on the mechanisms of acupuncture and on anesthesiology. Indications and evaluation later became more cautious.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 赤脚医生与农村合作医疗
events.title_en: Barefoot doctors and the rural cooperative medical system
events.summary: 1960年代末赤脚医生与农村合作医疗兴起，中西医适宜技术广泛进入基层，影响全球初级卫生保健讨论。
events.summary_en: In the late 1960s barefoot doctors and the rural cooperative medical system arose. Appropriate techniques of Chinese and Western medicine entered the grassroots widely and influenced the global discussion of primary health care.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 巴纳德首例人体心脏移植
events.title_en: Barnard’s first human heart transplant
events.summary: 克里斯蒂安·巴纳德1967年在南非完成首例人体心脏移植，引发全球移植伦理与技术热潮。
events.summary_en: In 1967 Christiaan Barnard completed the first human heart transplant in South Africa, setting off a global wave of transplant ethics and technique.

events.title: 法瓦罗罗冠状动脉旁路移植
events.title_en: Favaloro’s coronary artery bypass
events.summary: 雷内·法瓦罗罗1967年发展冠状动脉旁路移植术（CABG），成为缺血性心脏病主要外科疗法。
events.summary_en: In 1967 René Favaloro developed coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG), which became a principal surgical treatment of ischemic heart disease.

events.title: 小夹板治疗骨折推广
events.title_en: Small splints for fractures are promoted
events.summary: 约1970年全国中草药与新医疗法展览等场合推广小夹板固定治疗骨折，体现中西医结合骨伤特色。
events.summary_en: About 1970, at the national exhibition of Chinese herbs and new therapies and on similar occasions, fixation of fractures with small splints was promoted. It expresses a Chinese-Western integrative approach to traumatology.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 屠呦呦青蒿素抗疟突破
events.title_en: Tu Youyou’s antimalarial breakthrough with artemisinin
events.summary: 1971年10月4日屠呦呦课题组获青蒿乙醚中性提取物对鼠疟100%抑制，后分离青蒿素；启发自《肘后备急方》。2015年获诺贝尔奖。
events.summary_en: On 4 October 1971 Tu Youyou’s group obtained a neutral ether extract of qinghao that fully inhibited rodent malaria, and artemisinin was later isolated. The lead came from the Zhouhou Beiji Fang. She received the Nobel Prize in 2015.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 亨斯菲尔德CT扫描
events.title_en: Hounsfield’s CT scan
events.summary: 戈弗雷·亨斯菲尔德1971年前后推出商业CT，实现断层成像，彻底改变诊断放射学。
events.summary_en: Around 1971 Godfrey Hounsfield introduced commercial CT, making tomographic imaging possible and thoroughly changing diagnostic radiology.

events.title: MMR疫苗（希勒曼）
events.title_en: MMR vaccine (Hilleman)
events.summary: 莫里斯·希勒曼等1971年推出麻疹—腮腺炎—风疹联合疫苗，成为儿童免疫规划核心。
events.summary_en: In 1971 Maurice Hilleman and others introduced the combined measles-mumps-rubella vaccine, which became a core of childhood immunization programs.

events.title: 北京南京上海国际针灸培训中心
events.title_en: International acupuncture training centers in Beijing, Nanjing, and Shanghai
events.summary: 1975年应WHO要求，北京、南京、上海成立国际针灸培训中心，推动针灸全球化教学。
events.summary_en: In 1975, at the request of the WHO, international acupuncture training centers were established in Beijing, Nanjing, and Shanghai, promoting the global teaching of acupuncture.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 首例试管婴儿出生
events.title_en: Birth of the first baby conceived by in vitro fertilization
events.summary: 1978年路易斯·布朗出生，标志体外受精（IVF）临床成功，生殖医学进入新阶段。
events.summary_en: Louise Brown was born in 1978, marking the clinical success of in vitro fertilization (IVF) and a new stage of reproductive medicine.

events.title: WHO推荐针灸适应症
events.title_en: The WHO recommends indications for acupuncture
events.summary: 1979年世界卫生组织向各国推荐针灸可试用于偏头痛等数十种病症，并推动国际针灸培训。
events.summary_en: In 1979 the World Health Organization recommended to member states that acupuncture could be tried for several dozen conditions, including migraine, and it promoted international acupuncture training.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 乙肝疫苗问世
events.title_en: A hepatitis B vaccine becomes available
events.summary: 1980年前后首个乙型肝炎疫苗可用（与巴鲁克·布卢姆伯格等研究相关），显著降低乙肝与肝癌负担。
events.summary_en: Around 1980 the first hepatitis B vaccine became available, in connection with the research of Baruch Blumberg and others. It sharply reduced the burden of hepatitis B and liver cancer.

events.title: 商业MRI扫描仪
events.title_en: Commercial MRI scanners
events.summary: 约1980年达马迪安等推动商业磁共振成像扫描仪，无电离辐射软组织成像迅速普及。
events.summary_en: About 1980 Raymond Damadian and others advanced commercial magnetic-resonance imaging scanners. Soft-tissue imaging without ionizing radiation spread quickly.

events.title: WHO宣布消灭天花
events.title_en: The WHO declares smallpox eradicated
events.summary: 1980年世界卫生组织正式宣布天花消灭，是人类通过疫苗与公共卫生协作根除的第一种人类疾病。
events.summary_en: In 1980 the World Health Organization formally declared smallpox eradicated, the first human disease eliminated by the collaboration of vaccination and public health.

events.title: 宪法规定发展传统医药
events.title_en: The Constitution provides for the development of traditional medicine
events.summary: 1982年《中华人民共和国宪法》规定“发展现代医药和我国传统医药”，从根本法层面确立中医药地位。
events.summary_en: In 1982 the Constitution of the People’s Republic of China provided for “developing modern medicine and our traditional medicine,” establishing the standing of Chinese medicine in the fundamental law.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 重组人胰岛素上市
events.title_en: Recombinant human insulin comes on the market
events.summary: 1982年重组人胰岛素获批，是基因工程药物进入临床的标志。
events.summary_en: Recombinant human insulin was approved in 1982, a marker of genetically engineered drugs entering clinical use.

events.title: 分离出艾滋病病毒（HIV）
events.title_en: Isolation of the AIDS virus (HIV)
events.summary: 巴斯德研究所巴尔-西诺西、蒙塔尼耶团队从患者淋巴结分离出逆转录病毒，后定名为HIV，2008年获诺贝尔生理学或医学奖。
events.summary_en: A team at the Institut Pasteur led by Françoise Barré-Sinoussi and Luc Montagnier isolated a retrovirus from a patient's lymph node, later named HIV. They shared the 2008 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine.

events.title: 穆利斯发明PCR
events.title_en: Mullis invents PCR
events.summary: 凯利·穆利斯1985年发明聚合酶链式反应（PCR），使核酸扩增成为诊断与分子生物学常规工具。
events.summary_en: In 1985 Kary Mullis invented the polymerase chain reaction (PCR), making nucleic-acid amplification a routine tool of diagnosis and molecular biology.

events.title: 国家中医管理局成立
events.title_en: Founding of the State Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine
events.summary: 1986年国家中医管理局成立（1988年更名国家中医药管理局），中医药行政管理升格。
events.summary_en: In 1986 the State Administration of Chinese Medicine (Guojia Zhongyi Guanliju) was founded. In 1988 it was renamed the National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine (Guojia Zhongyiyao Guanliju). Administration of Chinese medicine was raised in rank.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 世界针灸学会联合会成立
events.title_en: Founding of the World Federation of Acupuncture-Moxibustion Societies
events.summary: 1987年世界针灸学会联合会成立，推动针灸国际学术交流与标准化。
events.summary_en: The World Federation of Acupuncture-Moxibustion Societies was founded in 1987, promoting international scholarly exchange and standardization in acupuncture.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 帕尔马兹血管支架
events.title_en: The Palmaz vascular stent
events.summary: 胡利奥·帕尔马兹等发展血管内支架，介入心脏病学进入支架时代。
events.summary_en: Julio Palmaz and others developed the intravascular stent, and interventional cardiology entered the stent era.

events.title: WHO经穴名称标准化方案
events.title_en: The WHO standard nomenclature of acupuncture points
events.summary: 1989年WHO通过经穴、经外奇穴、耳穴、头皮针等标准化穴名方案，便利国际交流与研究。
events.summary_en: In 1989 the WHO adopted standard nomenclature for channel points, extra points, auricular points, scalp acupuncture, and related points, which made international exchange and research easier.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title: 首例获批人体基因治疗
events.title_en: First approved human gene therapy
events.summary: 美国国立卫生研究院对一名腺苷脱氨酶缺乏型重症联合免疫缺陷（ADA-SCID）患儿回输经基因修饰的T细胞，是首个获批的人体基因治疗试验。
events.summary_en: At the US National Institutes of Health, a child with adenosine deaminase deficiency (ADA-SCID) received her own T cells after gene modification. It was the first approved human gene therapy trial.

events.title: 甲肝疫苗可用
events.title_en: A hepatitis A vaccine becomes available
events.summary: 1992年前后甲型肝炎疫苗投入使用，完善病毒性肝炎免疫预防。
events.summary_en: Around 1992 a hepatitis A vaccine came into use, completing the immunoprevention of viral hepatitis.

events.title: 卫生工作方针明确“中西医并重”
events.title_en: Health-work policy states “equal emphasis on Chinese and Western medicine”
events.summary: 1997年《中共中央国务院关于卫生改革与发展的决定》提出“中西医并重”等新时期卫生方针。
events.summary_en: In 1997 the Decision of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the State Council on Health Reform and Development set out “equal emphasis on Chinese and Western medicine” and other health policies for the new period.
sources_en: National Museum of Traditional Chinese Medicine

events.title_en: Draft of the Human Genome Project is completed
events.summary: 2000年人类基因组计划公布工作草图，推动基因组医学、靶向药物与分子诊断（完稿后续年份完善）。
events.summary_en: In 2000 the Human Genome Project published a working draft, advancing genomic medicine, targeted drugs, and molecular diagnosis. The finished sequence was refined in later years.
